You can specify the type of production and service, including the relevant pro- duction resources and tools or operating supplies. You can plan the maintenance of your products and production facili- ties with customer services and PM for preventive mainte- nance. Identification and traceability (and inspection status): The product must be clearly iden- tified during production; that is, the inspection status of a product must be indicated everywhere. SAP S/4HANA is quite flexible with regard to product identifi- cation and can easily meet the standard requirements. In each phase, you can print out the corresponding papers for identification and attach them to the goods, for example, the receipt of goods certificate for the inbound delivery, the pro- duction order for production, or the delivery note and the test certificate for the outbound delivery. It’s possible to print out labels with a barcode, if required. Identification and traceability (and inspection status): The product must be clearly iden- tified during production; that is, the inspection status of a product must be indicated everywhere. SAP S/4HANA is quite flexible with regard to product identifi- cation and can easily meet the standard requirements. In each phase, you can print out the corresponding papers for identification and attach them to the goods, for example, the receipt of goods certificate for the inbound delivery, the pro- duction order for production, or the delivery note and the test certificate for the outbound delivery. It’s possible to print out labels with a barcode, if required. Standard ISO 9001 Requirement Implementation Option in SAP S/4HANA Table 1.2 How SAP S/4HANA Supports the ISO 9001 Certification (Cont.) 1 Quality Management in SAP S/4HANA 54 SAP S/4HANA also supports the management of physical samples and batches. Serial number management enables you to trace individual products, if necessary. The status of the products is documented in the system, for instance, via confirmation messages for certain operations. If required, you can also print out work papers or labels to indicate the inspection status. The system can be configured so that no product can be dis- patched without having completed the required inspections and having documented them. Property of the customer (products provided): The prop- erty of the customer must be identified, verified, and pro- tected. You can carry out verification with SAP S/4HANA, for instance, via goods receipt inspection. Product maintenance (stor- age, etc.): Suitable methods and processes for identifica- tion, handling, packing, stor- age, protection, and dispatch must be adopted. You can adjust your system to these standard requirements with MM, embedded EWM, and SAP S/4HANA Sales. For instance, for methods and processes that have to be adhered to at certain stages of the production process or with regard to product maintenance, you can include detailed descrip- tions as long texts at any time in routings and inspection plans. Control of monitoring and test equipment (test equip- ment monitoring): Test equipment, provided it’s nec- essary for the fulfillment of quality requirements, must be released and calibrated or verified at regular intervals. Records must be kept on the calibration and verification results. The combined possibilities of the PM and QM areas of SAP S/4HANA enable complete test equipment monitoring. This test equipment monitoring contains the master data for all test equipment, the status (locked, free, etc.), the manage- ment (who has which item of test equipment where), and the calibration monitoring, which ensures that each item of test equipment subject to monitoring is regularly recali- brated on the basis of a maintenance plan. As usual, all data on test equipment monitoring is stored in the system data- base and is available for information or further evaluation. It’s also possible to integrate a subsystem that may already exist for test equipment monitoring, which communicates with the SAP S/4HANA system through a dedicated interface. Standard ISO 9001 Requirement Implementation Option in SAP S/4HANA Table 1.2 How SAP S/4HANA Supports the ISO 9001 Certification (Cont.) © 55
sections.he:
טבלה 1.2 מציגה את אלמנטי הליבה של תקן ISO 9001 ואפשרויות היישום ב-S/4HANA (רק דרישות מהותיות; ניתוח מלא חורג מהיקף הטבלה):

טבלה 1.2 — כיצד S/4HANA תומך בהסמכת ISO 9001 (דרישת ISO 9001 | אפשרות יישום):
| **מערכת QM:** זיהוי והגדרת תהליכים, תיעוד, ובקרת מסמכים ורשומות | התהליכים זוהו והוגדרו בהכנסת S/4HANA ובבחירת הפונקציונליות (בפרט QM). תיעוד היישום משמש גם לתיעוד מערכת ה-QM. |
| **דרישות תיעוד:** בקרת מסמכים ורשומות | המערכת מתוכננת כך שהדרישה ממולאת. כל יצירה/שינוי נרשמים עם שם משתמש, תאריך ושעה. השחרור לאחר בדיקה ב-status concept, וההרשאות ב-authorization concept. הרשאות מיוחדות — חתימה דיגיטלית. ‏DMS מתאים במיוחד. |
| **אחריות הנהלה:** הגדרת אחריות וסמכות, אספקת משאבים, והערכת QM | היישום, השימוש במודולים, האחריויות לתהליכים, וה-authorization concept מבטיחים עמידה. מערכות המידע מספקות גישה לכמעט כל העובדות להערכת QM. |
| **יכולת, מודעות והדרכה:** זיהוי דרישת ההדרכה, השגת כישורים, ותחזוקת רשומות | ניתן לעמוד בדרישת רישום סטטוס ההדרכה ב-HR. |
| **הערכת דרישות חוזיות למוצר (בדיקת חוזה וניהול שינויים):** בדיקת הדרישות והיכולת | נתמך בתחומים שונים. חוזים ב-DMS; אב החומר לסקירת הדרישות; ‏PP ו-EWM לבדיקת קיבולת; ‏ECM עם change master record לניהול שינויי חוזה. |
| **פיתוח (design control):** תכנון פיתוח ושלבים, ממשקים, אימות ותיקוף תוצאות, תיעוד שינויים | מכוסה ברובו בקיים. תכנון פרויקט ושלבים ב-PS; ‏SAP PLM לאינטגרציה לשרשרת ול-QM. הממשקים החשובים — רכש (MM) וייצור (PP). מפרטי הרכש זמינים (אב חומר, ‏purchasing info record, ‏supplier info record, ‏quality info record). לאימות — בדיקות מתוכננות ב-QM. |
| **בקרת ייצור ושירותים (process control):** תכנון וביצוע מבוקרים | מסלולים (routings) לתכנון; ‏customer services ו-PM לאחזקה מונעת. |
| **זיהוי ועקיבות (וסטטוס בדיקה):** זיהוי ברור של המוצר בייצור | גמיש מאוד — ניתן להדפיס ניירות זיהוי בכל שלב (תעודת GR, הזמנת ייצור, תעודת בדיקה, label עם ברקוד). תומך בניהול דגימות ואצוות; ‏serial number management לעקיבת מוצרים בודדים. ניתן להגדיר שאף מוצר לא יישלח ללא בדיקות מושלמות ומתועדות. |
| **רכוש הלקוח:** זיהוי, אימות והגנה | אימות ב-goods receipt inspection. |
| **תחזוקת מוצר (אחסון וכו'):** שיטות לזיהוי, טיפול, אריזה, אחסון, הגנה ומשלוח | התאמה ב-MM, ‏EWM, ו-Sales. תיאורים מפורטים כ-long texts במסלולים ובתוכניות בדיקה. |
| **בקרת ציוד ניטור ובדיקה:** שחרור, כיול/אימות במרווחים, ושמירת רשומות | שילוב PM ו-QM מאפשר ניטור מלא — נתוני אב, סטטוס (נעול/חופשי), ניהול (מי/היכן), וניטור כיול (recalibration לפי maintenance plan). ניתן לשלב subsystem קיים דרך ממשק ייעודי. |
| **Internal audit:** תכנון תוכנית ביקורת (קריטריונים, היקף, תדירות, שיטות), ותחזוקת רשומות | נתמך ישירות; ניתן גם quality notification לתיעוד ועקיבת ביקורות. |
| **שיפורים (corrective/preventive action):** הערכת שגיאות (כולל תלונות לקוח), קביעת סיבות, מניעת הישנות, יזימת פעולות, רישום והערכה | יישום ישיר ב-QM וב-PP. ‏corrective/preventive עובדים דרך רישום השגיאות לתוצאות הבדיקה ול-usage decision. ניתן action catalogs, או free texts ו-quality notifications, עם עקיבה וניטור לאורך זמן. תלונות לקוח נרשמות ומנוטרות דרך ה-notification. |

**הערת יועץ:** ISO-9001 + S/4HANA — QM מיישם דרישות-תקן (processes-defined, documents-controlled). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, כל-דרישת-ISO ממופה לאובייקט-SAP (inspection-plan, quality-notification, DMS לבקרת-מסמכים, audit-management). יועץ מנוסה ממפה תקן→יישום: QM-system מתועד דרך-הגדרות-QM. ההבחנה דרישת-תקן (מה) מול-אופציית-יישום (איך ב-SAP). audit-trail + traceability = ליבת-ISO. הבנת-ISO-9001-mapping חיונית — QM ב-S/4HANA הוא-כלי-לעמידה-רגולטורית, לא-רק-בקרה-תפעולית.

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 1.5 Summary 1.5 Summary This chapter began with covering what QM is and the importance of QM integration with logistics and areas of supply chain management. The QM master data objects are important during processes relevant for ensuring product quality. We continued with the business processes within QM, starting with quality engineering. Then, we also quickly showed you how QM relates to the rest of the SAP S/4HANA landscape, as it’s important to understand the enterprise structure of various SAP S/4HANA systems that you’ll use throughout the book. Setting up the correct and complete enterprise struc- ture is one of the key success factors for ensuring effective reporting that eventually helps in making important and strategic business decisions. The chapter also covered how SAP S/4HANA supports the ISO 9001 certification process. In the next chapter, we begin our journey in the QM area with a look at quality plan- ning. Internal audit: An audit pro- gram must be planned— criteria, scope, frequency, and methods must be defined— and records must be main- tained. Audit management is directly supported by the SAP S/4HANA system. You can also use the quality notification to document and trace audits. Improvements (corrective and preventive action): Corrective measures must evaluate errors, including customer complaints. You’ll find the direct implementation of these requirements in the QM and PP areas in particu- lar. You can create, trace, and determine causes, prevent recurring errors, initiate mea- sures, record results, and evaluate measures. Preventive measures must determine possible errors and causes, prevent the occurrence of errors, initiate actions, record results, and evaluate actions; corrective and preven- tive actions work directly through error recording for the inspection results and the use decision. You can use your own action catalogs or initiate individual measures or actions using free texts and quality notifications, and you can trace and monitor these over time. All information and quality records are available from in-process and final inspec- tions involving production. You can record customer com- plaints, initiate corresponding actions, and further trace them via the quality notification. The SAP S/4HANA system can provide information at any time on all actions, steps, and their processing status, as well as provide information for a QM evaluation. Standard ISO 9001 Requirement Implementation Option in SAP S/4HANA Table 1.2 How SAP S/4HANA Supports the ISO 9001 Certification (Cont.) ©
sections.he:
הפרק פתח במהות QM ובחשיבות האינטגרציה עם הלוגיסטיקה ושרשרת האספקה. אובייקטי נתוני האב חשובים בתהליכים להבטחת איכות. המשכנו בתהליכי QM, החל מהנדסת איכות, ובקשר של QM לשאר ה-S/4HANA landscape (חשוב להבין את המבנה הארגוני של המערכות בספר). הקמת מבנה ארגוני נכון ומלא — גורם הצלחה מרכזי לדיווח יעיל ולהחלטות אסטרטגיות. הפרק כיסה גם כיצד S/4HANA תומך בהסמכת ISO 9001. הפרק הבא — תכנון איכות (quality planning).

לסיכום, פרק-זה החל בכיסוי מהו-QM וחשיבות אינטגרציית-ה-QM עם-הלוגיסטיקה ותחומי-שרשרת-האספקה. אובייקטי-נתוני-האב של-QM חשובים במהלך-תהליכים הרלוונטיים להבטחת-איכות-מוצר. המשכנו בתהליכי-העסק בתוך-QM, החל-מ-quality-engineering. לאחר-מכן, הראינו במהירות כיצד-QM מתקשר לשאר-נוף-ה-S/4HANA, שכן-חשוב-להבין את-מבנה-הארגון של-מערכות-ה-S/4HANA השונות שתשתמש-בהן לאורך-הספר. הקמת-מבנה-ארגוני נכון-ומלא היא-אחד-מגורמי-ההצלחה המרכזיים. עבור-היועץ, התובנה-החותמת של-הפרק: ה-QM אינו-מודול-מבודד אלא-שכבת-איכות אופקית המשתלבת בכל-שרשרת-הערך — MM (בדיקת-רכש), PP (בדיקות-ייצור), Sales (בדיקת-משלוח), PM (calibration), ו-EWM (איכות-במחסן). שלושת-תהליכי-הליבה — quality-engineering (תכנון-מראש), assurance-and-control (בקרה-שוטפת), ו-improvement (שיפור-מכשלים) — יחד עם-product-change-management מרכיבים מעגל-איכות מלא. ההבחנה שהפרק ביסס — בין-המבנה-הארגוני (client/company-code/plant/storage-location/warehouse-number) לתהליכי-האיכות — מהותית: המבנה הוא-השלד, ה-QM הוא-שכבת-האיכות עליו. הבנת-יסודות-אלה חיונית — הם-הבסיס לכל-הספר. הפרקים-הבאים יעמיקו בנתוני-האב, בתכנון-הבדיקות, ובביצוע-תהליכי-האיכות בפועל.

**הערת יועץ וסיכום מורחב:** הפרק כיסה מהו-QM, אינטגרציה עם-לוגיסטיקה, נתוני-אב, תהליכי-QM, ומבנה-ארגוני. עבור-היועץ, התובנה-החותמת: QM = שכבת-איכות אופקית חוצת-שרשרת-ערך — MM (רכש), PP (ייצור), Sales (משלוח), PM (calibration), EWM (מחסן). שלושה-תהליכי-ליבה (engineering/assurance-control/improvement) + product-change-management = מעגל-איכות מלא (PDCA). ההבחנה מבנה-ארגוני (client/company-code/plant/storage-location/warehouse-number) מול-שכבת-QM עליו. ⚠️ תוכן: QM, לא-EWM (למרות-שם-הספר; EWM = תת-אינטגרציה בלבד). מבנה-נכון = גורם-הצלחה-מרכזי. הבנת-היסודות חיונית — בסיס-כל-הספר. הפרקים-הבאים: נתוני-אב, תכנון-בדיקות, ביצוע.

sections.title: Quality Management View in Material Master
sections.en: 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master Let’s now delve into discussing and maintaining the important master data of Table 2.1. 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master When a company decides to implement QM to integrate its business processes with logistics and the supply chain and to bring about improvements to business processes, one of the very first master data maintenance tasks required is maintaining the Quality management view of the material master. The material master record in the SAP system is a complex and central entity, the pur- pose of which is to control business and logistical processes. For the sake of clarity and visibility, the system divides the material master record into different views. Maintain- ing master data is a combined and collective responsibility of various departments or persons. There is also the Quality management view (see Figure 2.1) of the material master. If this view of the material isn’t available initially, the person responsible for the material master record can add it later at any time. This has no effect on any part of the logistics process (e.g., inventory management, procurement, production). The functions for inspection-lot creation, stock posting, and—in particular—QM procure- ment control are activated later, when the Quality management view is maintained further. You set up an inspection type in the Quality management view of the material master, which acts as a control function for all subsequent activities. An inspection type is the basic identifier for the different types of inspections available in the SAP system. To add an inspection type to a material master, use Transaction MM02 or follow menu path SAP  Logistics  Materials Management  Material Master  Material  Change  Immediately. In the screen that appears, enter Material “RM17” and Plant “1710”, and then click Quality Management to go to the Quality management view, as shown in Figure 2.1. Material specification QM/MM Material master record Quality info record: procure- ment QM/MM Procurement Quality info record: sales QM/SAP S/4HANA Sales Sales General Master Data Area(s) Use in QM Table 2.1 Master Data of QM and Its Use in Other Logistics Areas (Cont.) 2 Quality Planning 60 Figure 2.1 Quality Management View of Material Master Tips and Tricks If the Quality management view hasn’t been previously maintained, use Transaction MM01 to create the Quality management view of the material master first. Figure 2.1 shows the Quality management view of material RM17 for plant 1710, which includes the following important fields:  QM Material Auth. (authorization) helps to control who is authorized to perform inspection-related tasks on this material. This field also controls the digital signature in SAP, which is discussed in Chapter 3.  GR Processing Time is the average number of working days it takes it to process an inspection lot. The system uses this information during material requirements planning (MRP) to take the inspection duration into account while planning pro- curement, production, or availability of a material.  A Catalog Profile consists of defects and defect locations and is available during quality notification creation (see Chapter 12 for more details).  Material Status is the control function that allows or disallows the functions or busi- ness processes possible for this material. For example, a control function such as a material may be blocked from procurement, or the material may be obsolete.  Inspection Interval denotes the frequency with which a batch-managed material under- goes recurring (repeat) inspection. Recurring inspection is discussed in Chapter 9. © 61 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master The control functions in the Procurement Data area are covered in Chapter 4. Click on the Insp. Setup button in Figure 2.1 to go to Figure 2.2, which shows the initial screen of Inspection Setup Data. Because no inspection type existed when you first clicked on the Insp. Setup button, you’ll find a blank screen. You can incorporate or set up a new inspection type with the Inspection Types button shown in Figure 2.2. Inspection type 01 is relevant for the quality inspection of raw material (or other procured materials) on goods receipt against a purchase order. It’s important to note that assignment of an inspection type to a material is plant-specific. You can assign more than one inspection type to a material. For example, a batch-man- aged finished good with a shelf-life expiration date is inspected on its production com- pletion (known as goods receipt inspection against production order), but then the same finished good also undergoes periodic inspection if it remains unsold and its batch’s shelf life is about to expire (known as recurring inspection). Figure 2.2 Inspection Setup Data 2 Quality Planning 62 Consider another example: the company’s business process requires inspection of a raw material at the supplier’s premises for compliance with important quality parameters prior to its delivery into the company’s warehouse (known as source inspection). The same raw material will again go through another round of quality inspection when the goods reach the company’s warehouse (known as goods receipt inspection against the purchase order). This requires activation of two different inspection types. The first inspection type is for inspection at the supplier premises, and the second inspection type is for inspection at the company’s premises. When you want to activate a specific inspection type, you need to ensure that the Active checkbox is selected. Due to changes in the business process, if a particular inspection type is no longer needed, simply dese- lecting the Active checkbox deactivates it. This is the easiest way to deactivate an inspec- tion type at any time. You can also delete the entire inspection type, if needed. Based on your business needs and at any point in time, you can add a new inspection type or make changes to control indicators of an already existing inspection type in Inspection Setup. Warning On deactivating or deleting an inspection type, you first have to ensure that there is no quality stock. Now, click Insp. type det. (inspection type details; the right button [the magnifying glass]) to view the details of the fields and other options available for inspection type 01. Table 2.2 explains some of the important fields of Figure 2.2. Control Indicator Effects Post to Insp. Stock Posts a goods movement to the inspection stock for the material. Only in the QM area, within the scope of the usage decision, can you release anything out of quality inspection stock. In an exceptional case, the movement type itself enables the system to determine whether to post the quantity to inspection stock. Insp. with Mat Spec. With this indicator set, you can use a material specifica- tion to carry out an inspection. An inspection that uses a material specification can be in addition to, or even replace, an inspection that uses a routing or a master rec- ipe. You need to completely maintain a material specifica- tion for the material to carry out an inspection. Refer to Section 2.12 on how to set up a material specification. Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup © 63 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master Insp. with Task List With this indicator set, the system requires a task list for an inspection with the inspection lot. The decision on whether a routing or a master recipe is required is made during inspection data maintenance in the material mas- ter record. The system can only determine the sample size after assignment of the task list to the inspection lot. In Chapter 3, you’ll see that when the system is unable to find and assign a task list to an inspection lot, it’s unable to calculate the sample size. Insp. by Configuration If this indicator is set, the system takes configurations from the sales order or production order into account in inspection-lot creation. Automatic Assignment The system tries to automatically assign a routing, an inspection plan, or a material specification to the inspec- tion lot. Inspect Charcs If you want characteristic-based results recording, you have to use a routing, an inspection plan, or a material specification for the inspection. Characteristic-based results recording is a prerequisite for characteristic-based dynamic modification. You can select a dynamic modifi- cation level in an inspection plan. Smpl. Procedure A procedure to determine the size of the sample in an inspection. The sampling procedure also defines the valu- ation type used for results recording (attributive, variable, manual, etc.). This field is of significance only in an inspection that doesn’t use a routing, master recipe, or material specifica- tion. If you enter a sampling procedure here, the system calculates the total sample size from the lot size. Select a sampling procedure that uses a valuation mode without valuation parameters. In the case of an inspection without a routing, master rec- ipe, or material specification, you have the following options to determine the inspection scope for a specific material:  100% inspection  Specify a percentage  Specify a sampling procedure without valuation parameters Control Indicator Effects Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup (Cont.) 2 Quality Planning 64 100% Inspection There are two possible business scenarios that you need to consider while setting up this indicator:  Inspect without routing, master recipe, or material specification The system creates the sample size as equal to the cre- ated lot.  Inspect with routing, master recipe, or material speci- fication The sample size of the created lot is the same as the lot size. The sampling procedure set down in the inspection plan or specification isn’t taken into account in the sample determination process for the inspection characteristics. Instead, the system uses sample determination rules, which are preset in the configuration. The sample size of the created charac- teristics depends on whether the base unit of measure has decimal places. If the base unit of measure does have decimal places, the sample size of the character- istic is always 1; if the base unit of measure doesn’t have decimal places, 100% of the lot size should be inspected in sample units of measure (rounded up) for the characteristic. Here, the dependencies are that if in addition to either 100% inspection, Inspect with Task List, or Insp. by Config- uration indicators, you also set the Skips Allowed charac- teristic, nothing changes in the sample calculation. However, the system does check whether the characteris- tic is to be inspected or not. Inspection % This field is of significance only in an inspection that doesn’t use a routing, master recipe, task list, or material specification. In this case, the system calculates the over- all sample size using this percentage value from the inspection lot size. Manual Sample Calc. Set this indicator if you want to manually trigger the sam- ple calculation for the inspection lot. Manual Sample Entry If this checkbox is selected, then you need to manually enter the sample size for the inspection of this inspection lot. This characteristic is only taken into account in inspections that don’t use a routing, task list, or material specification. Control Indicator Effects Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup (Cont.) © 65 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master Dyn. Mod. Rule This is for the dynamic modification rule. It contains defi- nitions of the inspection levels and the conditions that cause inspection levels to change. This field is significant only in an inspection that doesn’t use a routing or mate- rial specification. If you enter a dynamic modification rule here, a quality level for the material, plant, and inspection type is set, and when the quality level is created automat- ically, the system calculates the dynamic modification cri- teria for the inspection-lot origin. If, in addition to the sample size, you control using a sampling procedure, the system checks whether the combination of dynamic modification rule and sampling procedure is permitted (permitted relationships). Refer to Chapter 3, which cov- ers the dynamic modification rule in detail. Skips Allowed If you set this indicator, then the system allows skipping results recording for inspection characteristics when it calculates the sample size of the lot. The characteristic takes effect in the inspection lot if it’s set in the QM inspection data of the material for the inspection type in question. If the characteristic isn’t set in the dynamic modification process, the system selects the next nonskip inspection level instead of a skip level. If all the characteristics to be inspected in an inspection lot have the Skip status, it results in a skip inspection lot. In the case of a skip lot, if both skips and automatic usage decision are allowed, inspection-lot processing is carried out without any user intervention. A time delay can be set for this in the configuration. This triggers unrestricted stock at the goods receipt stage because the lot quantity is immediately posted to unrestricted-use stock. In the QM control function in procurement (quality infor- mation record), you can make a setting that skips the goods receipt inspections. You can also specify for the material in the inspection data that an inspection is to be carried out only for the first goods receipt per order or production order. To prevent individual characteristics from being skipped, proceed as follows:  Assign characteristic weightings to the characteristics to prevent skips.  Assign sampling procedures to the characteristics that don’t permit stage changes. Control Indicator Effects Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup (Cont.) 2 Quality Planning 66 Automatic UD If you set this indicator, the system can automatically make usage decisions for inspection lots. The inspection lots have to fulfill the following conditions:  All characteristics are completed.  No characteristic has been rejected.  No defects have been recorded, and no quality notifi- cation has been created. The lead time set in configuration must have expired. Inspection lots with the status Skip Lot can also be con- sidered here. If an automatic usage decision can’t be made, you’ll have to make it manually. The system records an automatic usage decision in the long text that accompanies the usage decision. Chapter 3 shows you how to make automatic usage deci- sions for skipped inspection lots. Avg. Insp. Duration Specifies the average duration, in days, of the inspection for every inspection type. If the start date of the inspec- tion is entered during inspection-lot creation, the system calculates the end date using the average inspection time entered in this field. Conversely, if the end date of the inspection is entered during inspection-lot creation, the system calculates the start date using the average inspec- tion time entered in this field. Q-Score Procedure The coded ID of the procedure that the system uses to cal- culate the quality score. You can maintain one quality score procedure per inspection type in the material mas- ter record. The system transfers the information main- tained in this field to the inspection lot record on inspection lot creation. In the simplest procedure, the quality score is taken from the code for the usage decision. In another procedure, the quality score is calculated on the basis of the scrap share in the inspected characteristics. Allowed Scrap Share Some quality score procedures require an allowed scrap share to calculate the quality score. In normal cases, the scrap share is set to be half the acceptable quality level (AQL) value. Control Indicator Effects Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup (Cont.) © 67 2.1 Quality Management View in Material Master Control Lot Creation This control applies to goods receipt for inspection lot ori- gins 01, 04, 05, and 08. You can make the following settings:  <Space>: One inspection lot per goods receipt docu- ment item. In other words, one inspection lot is cre- ated for each goods receipt document item.  X: One inspection lot per purchase order item or order item and batch. If you set this value, the system cre- ates an inspection lot only for the first goods receipt for each purchase order item or production order, or, if the material is managed in batches, only for the first goods receipt per purchase order item or production order and batch. This setting is restricted to the inspec- tion lot origins For Purchase Order (Inspection Lot Ori- gin 01) and For Production Order (Inspection Lot Origin 04).  1: One inspection lot per material document, material, and batch. If you set this value, the system opens only one inspection lot per material and batch (in the case of batch management) for a material document (i.e., within a goods receipt transaction). This can occur if several purchase orders or several partial deliveries of the same material are processed within one goods receipt transaction.  2: One inspection lot per material and batch. If you set this value, the system opens only one inspection lot per material and batch (in the case of batch manage- ment). This setting is useful only for materials that require batch management. In the case of X, 1, and 2, if the stock of the inspection lot that was created with the first goods receipt isn’t com- pletely discharged or its usage decision made when fur- ther partial deliveries are received, these goods receipt quantities are added to this stock. In the case of 1 and 2, if Skip Lot is set, there is no direct change of the stock type from In Quality Inspection to Unrestricted Use. Instead, a transfer posting takes place as part of an automatic usage decision with a time delay. Control Indicator Effects Table 2.2 Inspection Types Setup (Cont.) 2 Quality Planning 68 Tips and Tricks When you’re maintaining the control indicator of the inspection data, we recommend that you use the predefined and default configuration settings for each inspection type. This is important because different entries for the same inspection type cause different materials to be used or cause difficulties with the inspection-lot generation process. If a special inspection lot control process is required on the material level for the same inspection type, this must be carefully documented in each individual case. For more information, see Chapter 3, which covers the configuration details of main- taining default values for inspection types. Table 2.3 contains a selective list of inspection types of respective inspection origins that we cover in various chapters of this book. The last column is the number of the chapter in which you’ll find detailed configuration, master data setup, requirements, or business processes that use the specific inspection type. Individual QM order This characteristic specifies that you need to create an individual QM order with an account assignment when the system creates an inspection lot for this inspection type. If you set this characteristic, you’re specifying that an individual QM order should be opened for this combi- nation of material and inspection type. If the field for the QM order is filled and the characteristic for individual QM orders is set, this field is taken into account only if the system is unable to create an individ- ual QM order due to a missing account assignment in the inspection lot. A prerequisite for creating an individual QM order is that the inspection lot contains an allocation provision such as sales order, cost center, or plant. QM Order A number that uniquely identifies the QM order to which the costs are to be charged. The QM order specified in the material master record in the inspection data is used as a template for inspection-lot creation if an individual QM order hasn’t been created for the inspection lot. Even if you configure new or extra inspection types, the problem still remains. This is because the inspection ori- gins to which you have to assign the inspection type are preconfigured and delivered. You therefore have no choice but to individually change the relevant control indicators under Inspection Data in the Quality management view of the material. In such a case, the only configuration tasks are to customize the short name of the inspection type and the global control indicator for each existing inspection type. For this reason, we don’t recommend that you create new inspection types to meet this business need. Chapter 3 shows how you can configure a new inspection type and use it in business processes.
sections.he:
אחת ממשימות נתוני האב הראשונות ביישום QM היא תחזוקת תצוגת Quality management של אב החומר.
רשומת אב החומר היא ישות מורכבת ומרכזית לבקרת תהליכים עסקיים ולוגיסטיים. המערכת מחלקת אותה לתצוגות. תחזוקה היא אחריות משותפת של מחלקות. תצוגת Quality management (Figure 2.1) — אם אינה זמינה בתחילה, ניתן להוסיפה בכל עת ללא השפעה על הלוגיסטיקה. פונקציות יצירת inspection lot, רישום מלאי, ובפרט בקרת רכש QM — מופעלות מאוחר, בתחזוקת התצוגה.
מגדירים inspection type בתצוגה — פונקציית בקרה לכל הפעילויות. ה-inspection type הוא המזהה הבסיסי לסוגי הבדיקות.
להוספה: Transaction MM02 או SAP • Logistics • Materials Management • Material Master • Material • Change • Immediately. הזינו Material "RM17", ‏Plant "1710", ובחרו Quality Management (Figure 2.1).
(טבלה 2.1 — נתוני אב QM: ‏Material specification [QM/MM, אב החומר]; ‏Quality info record: procurement [QM/MM, רכש]; ‏Quality info record: sales [QM/Sales, מכירות].)
**Tips and Tricks:** אם התצוגה לא תוחזקה, השתמשו ב-Transaction MM01 ליצירתה.
שדות חשובים (Figure 2.1):
• **QM Material Auth.:** מי מורשה לבצע בדיקות; שולט גם בחתימה הדיגיטלית (פרק 3).
• **GR Processing Time:** מספר ימי העבודה הממוצע לעיבוד inspection lot; ‏MRP משקלל אותו.
• **Catalog Profile:** פגמים ומיקומי-פגם, זמין ביצירת quality notification (פרק 12).
• **Material Status:** מתיר/אוסר פונקציות (למשל חסום מרכש, מיושן).
• **Inspection Interval:** תדירות הבדיקה החוזרת (recurring) לחומר מנוהל-אצווה (פרק 9).
(בקרות אזור Procurement Data — פרק 4.)
בחרו Insp. Setup (Figure 2.2 — מסך ריק כי אין inspection type). הוסיפו ב-Inspection Types. סוג 01 רלוונטי לבדיקת גלם (או נרכש אחר) ב-goods receipt מול הזמנת רכש. ההקצאה ספציפית-מפעל. ניתן מספר סוגים לחומר. למשל, גמור מנוהל-אצווה עם תפוגה — נבדק בהשלמת ייצור (GR מול הזמנת ייצור), ואז recurring בהתקרב התפוגה.
דוגמה נוספת: בדיקת גלם אצל הספק (source inspection) ואז שוב במחסן (GR מול הזמנת רכש) — שני סוגים. להפעלה, סמנו Active; להשבתה, בטלו את הסימון; ניתן גם למחוק.
**אזהרה:** בהשבתה/מחיקה, ודאו תחילה שאין quality stock.
בחרו Insp. type det. (זכוכית מגדלת) לפרטי סוג 01.

טבלה 2.2 — הקמת inspection types (מחווני בקרה | השפעות):
| **Post to Insp. Stock** | רושם תנועה ל-inspection stock; שחרור רק ב-QM דרך usage decision (או שסוג התנועה קובע). |
| **Insp. with Mat Spec.** | שימוש ב-material specification לבדיקה (בנוסף או במקום routing/master recipe). יש לתחזק במלואו (2.12). |
| **Insp. with Task List** | המערכת דורשת task list ל-lot. ההחלטה (routing או master recipe) בתחזוקת נתוני הבדיקה. גודל הדגימה נקבע רק לאחר הקצאת ה-task list. |
| **Insp. by Configuration** | המערכת שוקלת תצורות מהזמנת מכירה/ייצור ביצירת ה-lot. |
| **Automatic Assignment** | המערכת מנסה להקצות אוטומטית routing/inspection plan/material specification. |
| **Inspect Charcs** | לרישום תוצאות מבוסס-מאפיין נדרש routing/inspection plan/material specification — תנאי מוקדם ל-dynamic modification מבוסס-מאפיין. |
| **Smpl. Procedure** | נוהל לקביעת גודל הדגימה; מגדיר גם valuation type (attributive/variable/manual). משמעותי רק בבדיקה ללא routing/master recipe/material specification. אפשרויות היקף: 100% inspection; אחוז; sampling procedure ללא valuation parameters. |
| **100% Inspection** | ללא routing/recipe/spec — גודל הדגימה = ה-lot. עם routing/recipe/spec — גודל הדגימה = ה-lot, אך ה-sampling procedure בתוכנית אינו נשקל; המערכת משתמשת בכללי דגימה מהתצורה (תלוי במקומות עשרוניים של יחידת הבסיס: עם עשרוניים — דגימה 1; ללא — 100% מעוגל). |
| **Inspection %** | משמעותי רק ללא routing/recipe/task list/spec — המערכת מחשבת את הדגימה לפי אחוז מ-lot. |
| **Manual Sample Calc.** | הפעלה ידנית של חישוב הדגימה. |
| **Manual Sample Entry** | הזנה ידנית של גודל הדגימה (רק ללא routing/task list/spec). |
| **Dyn. Mod. Rule** | כלל dynamic modification — רמות בדיקה ותנאי המעבר. משמעותי רק ללא routing/spec (פרק 3). |
| **Skips Allowed** | מאפשר דילוג על רישום תוצאות בחישוב הדגימה. אם כל המאפיינים בדילוג → skip inspection lot. עם automatic UD → עיבוד ללא התערבות (delay בתצורה), והכמות ל-unrestricted ב-GR. |
| **Automatic UD** | usage decision אוטומטי אם: כל המאפיינים הושלמו; אף אחד לא נדחה; אין פגמים/notification; ה-lead time פג. אחרת — ידני. |
| **Avg. Insp. Duration** | משך הבדיקה הממוצע (ימים) — המערכת מחשבת תאריך סיום/התחלה. |
| **Q-Score Procedure** | נוהל חישוב ה-quality score (מקוד ה-usage decision, או לפי scrap share). |
| **Allowed Scrap Share** | חלק פסולת מותר לחישוב ה-score (בד"כ חצי מערך ה-AQL). |
| **Control Lot Creation** | ל-origins 01/04/05/08: רווח = lot אחד לפריט מסמך GR; ‏X = lot אחד לפריט הזמנה+אצווה (ל-origins 01, 04); ‏1 = lot אחד למסמך חומר/חומר/אצווה; ‏2 = lot אחד לחומר/אצווה. ב-X/1/2, מנות חלקיות מתווספות; ב-1/2 עם Skip Lot — transfer posting ב-automatic UD עם delay. |
| **Individual QM order** | יצירת QM order נפרד עם הקצאת חשבון ביצירת ה-lot. תנאי — הקצאה (הזמנת מכירה/מרכז עלות/מפעל). |
| **QM Order** | מספר ה-QM order לחיוב העלויות; משמש תבנית אם לא נוצר individual. |

**Tips and Tricks:** השתמשו בהגדרות ברירת המחדל לכל סוג; תיעוד מוקפד לתהליך מיוחד (פרק 3).
