**הערה:** Appendix A — רשימת סוגי תנועה ו-origins.

**Adapt Rules for Sample Determination:** אם ה-sampling procedure התקני אינו מספיק — function module. ל-... • Sample, SPC • Define Sampling Determination • Adapt Rules for Sample Determination.

**Define Valuation Mode:** מעריך מאפיינים — ידני/אוטומטי, attributive/variable. דוגמה: ‏mode 110 (Attr. Insp. Nonconforming Units/Manual) עם rule 111 — המערכת מקבלת/דוחה לפי כמה נכשלו (20 נבדקו, 3 נדחו; לפי function module QEBR_NONCONFORM_UNIT_OR_MANUAL). עם rule 10, אין אפשרות לדריסה ידנית.
**Tips and Tricks:** לכמותי — valuation mode מסוג variable; לאיכותי — attribute. ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality Planning • Basic Data • Sampling, SPC • Define Valuation Rules (Valuation Mode 100 — attributive, ‏rule 10).

**Define Valuation Rule:** ל-... • Define Sampling Determination • Modify Valuation Rule • Valuation Rule 10 (Figure 3.100 — function module). ל-unique — צרו function module.

**Statistical Process Control (SPC):** לשיפור איכות בהפחתת שונות. שני מקורות: ‏chance/common cause variation (אינהרנטי, יציב); ‏uncontrolled/special cause variation (לא-יציב, אירועים חיצוניים — מחוץ לבקרה). control charts מבחינים ביניהם. ביצירת מאפיין, סמנו SPC (וגם Sampling Procedure — אחרת ה-SPC מתבטל). בהקצאה ל-plan, המערכת מבקשת sampling procedure ו-SPC criteria. ל-... • Sampling, SPC • Statistical Process Control • Define SPC Criteria (Figure 3.101 — SPC Crit. 010). ‏Usage לבחירת task list; רדיו להקצאת ה-chart לכל lot או inspection point (פרק 19).

**Define Control Chart Type:** הגדירו: ‏Sample type (רק fixed); ‏Valuation mode (special — SPC inspection, לפי action limits; דחייה בהפרה; אם אין מספיק ערכים — ידני); ‏Control chart type (המערכת בודקת inspection points או independent multiple samples). charts עם זיכרון (moving average, ‏mean-value, ‏moving-range) אינם תומכים ב-SPC valuation mode. ל-n=1: אין S track; שונות כוללת ולא פנימית (ב-n=1 ה-standard deviation תמיד 0).
**Tips and Tricks:** ב-SPC עם measured recording, דגימה 3–10, ‏n=5 הנפוץ. לכמותיים ללא normal distribution — דגימה גדולה יותר (Shewhart charts).
ה-SPC criteria שולטים בעדכון ה-chart דרך function modules. ה-SAP מכיל:
• QRKS_CHARACTERISTIC: chart למאפיינים
• QRKS_INSPECTION_LOT: למאפיינים או lots
• QRKS_MATERIAL: למאפיינים או חומרים
• QRKS_MATERIAL_CUSTOMER: + לקוחות
• QRKS_MATERIAL_MANUFACTURER: + יצרנים
• QRKS_MATERIAL_SOLD_TO_PARTY: + sold-to
• QRKS_MATERIAL_VENDOR: + ספקים
• QRKS_MATERIAL_WORK_CENTER: + work centers
• QRKS_PURCHASING_DOCUMENT: או מסמכי רכש
• QRKS_SALES_ORDER: או הזמנות מכירה
ל-... • Define Control Chart Type (Ctrl Chart Type "110", ‏Details, ‏Figure 3.102). Figure 3.103 — type 110 (Shewhart chart ל-x-Bar); ‏Simulate. ‏Control chart tracks (Figure 3.104) — גבולות warning ו-action; ‏Change Control Limits לידני.
לאחר נתוני האב, נתוני תכנון בדיקה — general (כל הפעולות) ו-operation-specific. ‏QM משתמש ב-task list type Q, ומשתלב ב-routings, ‏rate routings, ‏master recipes, או reference operation set.

**Assign Task List Types to Material Types:** לסוגי חומר חדשים עם השלכות איכות. ל-... • Assign Task List Types to Material Types • Maintain Parameters for Task List Type (Figure 3.105 — צירוף TLType "Q" + MTyp).

**Planner Group:** לקיבוץ פעילויות (PM/PP/supply). ב-QM, מוקצה ב-task lists (לדיווח). ל-... • Inspection Planning • General • Define Planner Group.

**Define an Identifier for Inspection Points:** לדגימות, partial lots, ואובייקטי אחזקה. ל-... • Define Identifier for Inspection Points (Figure 3.106 — field combination 300, ‏InspPt type 1). סוגים: ‏(ריק) freely defined; ‏1 equipment; ‏2 functional location; ‏3 physical sample. עד שישה user fields (פורמט, אורך, סדר תצוגה ב-Field Act.). ‏Last Inspected Sample Is Valuated — רק התוצאות האחרונות תקפות (הקודמות invalid). לשונית Valuation — ברירות מחדל; לשונית Function modules — preset או מותאם (Use Func Component).

**Inspection-Characteristic Origin:** מזהה ייחודי למקור המאפיין. למשל, ‏FMEA (פרק 16) — בהעתקת מאפיין ל-plan, המערכת מבקשת origin. ל-... • Operation • Inspection Characteristic • Define Inspection-Characteristic Origin.

**Engineering Workbench:** לשינוי המוני. צרו/שנו working area. ל-... • Engineering Workbench • Define Work Areas (Working Area Q_OPR_000000000010, ‏Figure 3.107). רדיו/תיבות לתצוגה; ‏Lock Automatically (header/operation) למניעת שינוי בו-זמני; ‏Classification (פרק 9); ‏Object dependencies (variant configuration). השלמת lot — short-term (תוצאות לפני usage decision) ו-long-term (תוצאות גם אחרי) הם צעדים נפרדים.

**הערת יועץ:** quality-planning-config — defect-classes (5 קטגוריות: critical/major/minor...), catalogs, code-groups, sampling-procedures, DMRs. מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, ה-catalogs = שפת-הקודים של-כל-ה-QM (defects, attributes, UD). יועץ מנוסה בונה catalog-structure עקבית חוצת-מוצרים מוקדם — שינוי-מאוחר שובר-דוחות-היסטוריים. ההבחנה defaults (מספיקים-לרוב) מול-מותאם (רק-בצורך). הבנת-ה-planning-config חיונית — היא-שמזינה כל-plan וכל-MIC.

sections.title: Quality Inspection
sections.en: 3.6.4 Quality Inspection You can set up catalogs for usage decisions based on your business needs. Catalog type 3 is for usage decisions. To implement any usage decisions, you need to first imple- ment a quality score procedure, follow-up actions, and inventory postings. This section covers these configuration steps. Define Quality Score Procedure You can set a default value for determining a quality score in the inspection type. To do this, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Inspection Lot Completion  Define Quality Score Procedure. The screen that appears shows the available standard options. Chose Q-Score Procedure 01 to see the screen in Figure 3.108. Notice that a function module is assigned to under- take the necessary calculation for the quality score procedure. The Permitted Share of Scrap checkbox enables a certain percentage of defects to be considered during quality scores calculation. The Relevant Insp. Chars field provides an option to define whether the results of master inspection characteristics are considered for quality score calcula- tion, especially if the master inspection characteristics are closed and valuated. 3 Quality Inspection 226 Figure 3.108 Quality Scores To define a follow-up action, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Qual- ity Inspection  Inspection Lot Completion  Define Follow-Up Actions for Usage Deci- sions. In the popup that appears, choose Follow-Up Actions, which leads to the screen in Figure 3.109. Figure 3.109 Function Component for Follow-Up Actions Here, you see several standard follow-up actions available at various stages of quality inspection completion, especially at the usage decision level. Available options for fol- low-up actions include the cancellation of the inspection lot when the usage decision is rejected and sending a standard email to SAP users in the SAP mailbox, among others. © 227 3.6 Configuration Basics: Quality Planning and Quality Inspection Define Inventory Postings As you know, while performing a usage decision, you need to perform two sets of activ- ities:  Assigning the usage decision code, based on which the system calculates quality scores  Actual posting of inspection stock (for stock-based inspection) The menu path to define inventory posting is SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Inspection Lot Completion  Define Inventory Postings. In Figure 3.110, notice the relevant movement types that are already assigned to each of the inventory postings. For example, in the case of transfer posting a quality stock to scrap, the move- ment type that transfers the Q Stock (quality stock) To Scrap is 553. We recommend that you keep the standard settings unless you’ve created your own movement type to cater to a unique business need, which you can assign in this config- uration step. Figure 3.110 Inventory Postings with Usage Decisions The following section covers the configuration details of results recording. Define Recording Configuration During results recording, various options are available to facilitate the data entry pro- cess and determine whether you can automate some of the tasks. To make the necessary results recording settings, use menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Results Recording  Define Recording Configuration. In the change view recording configuration overview, choose Recording Config. option 1, which leads to the screen in Figure 3.111. Table 3.9 explains the fields shown. 3 Quality Inspection 228 Figure 3.111 Recording Configuration Checkbox Function Close on Continuing Closes the master inspection characteristic for further data input when you choose Continue (press (Enter)). Close when Navigating Closes the master inspection characteristics when the user navigates to a different screen during results recording. Autom. Close When Saving Closes the master inspection characteristics when the user saves the results after results recording. Autom. Save on Confirmation of Last Value When the user enters the last value of the master inspection characteristic, the system automatically saves the results and exits. Goto to next char., partial sample, insp. unit This automatically navigates to the next master inspection characteristic, partial sample, or inspection point when there are multiple input values. Goto the next operation to be inspected If there are multiple operations during the inspection, then the system moves to the next operation once the results for the preceding operations are entered or valuated. Skip Characteristic Overview Screen This option doesn’t navigate to the master inspection char- acteristic results recording overview once all results are entered. Rather, it prompts you to save the results and exit the results recording screen. Table 3.9 Results Recording Configuration © 229 3.6 Configuration Basics: Quality Planning and Quality Inspection Define Origins of Results Data Data origin is an identification of the source of data. In the standard SAP system, three options are available to choose from: electronic certificate from the supplier, test equipment results, and manual data entry. To define the source or origin of inspection results data, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Results Recording  Define Origin of Results Data. Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristics In this step, you can define the formula parameters for the input values of calculated characteristics. You can achieve this in the following two ways:  The formula parameters directly reference the fields in the input characteristics.  The formula parameters reference function modules, which calculate the values in the fields of the input characteristics. For example, to determine the difference between the mean values of two characteris- tics or samples, you need mean values for either characteristics or samples as input val- ues. Because these mean values are available in the characteristic record, you can give reference to the corresponding fields in the input characteristics. But to determine how many values for a quantitative characteristic are above a target value, you need a spe- cial function module that calculates this using a counting function. To define a parameter for a calculated characteristic, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Results Recording  Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristics. In the popup that appears, choose Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristic. A long list of standard parameters is available, and this is generally suffi- cient to cater to different business needs. Choose Parameter C0, which leads to the screen in Figure 3.112. Single Values Not Automati- cally Expanded Additional, single result lines don’t appear automatically on the General characteristic overview screen. Valuate on Enter Although there is an option to manually choose Valuate during results recording, you can automate this step by selecting this checkbox. Once the system checks whether the entered value (result) is inside or outside of the predefined range of values (speci- fications), it valuates the result for acceptance or rejection. Checkbox Function Table 3.9 Results Recording Configuration (Cont.) 3 Quality Inspection 230 Figure 3.112 QM Formula Parameters Here, the parameter C0 is basically the field name C0 in the respective table, and it’s the mean value of the measured value of a characteristic. Notice the option to Use Function Module to cater to any specific business need. Figure 3.113 Field Name Definitions © 231 3.6 Configuration Basics: Quality Planning and Quality Inspection Next, choose Assign Field Names to Parameters/Fields in the popup that appeared pre- viously, and choose parameter C0 again, so that the screen in Figure 3.113 appears. Table Name and Field: DB field show the database table where the system stores information that pertains to Field Name C0, which you can retrieve through several data table read- ing and retrieval options. Define Filter for Inspection Characteristics Before covering the configuration settings for the filters, use Transaction QE01 (Results Recording), choose the Char. Filter field dropdown, and take a quick look at the differ- ent available filters. You can configure these filter settings so that the system only dis- plays information per your preset filter. Because Transaction QE01 is just one of the several variants of characteristics’ results recording, you use other transactions for results recording, for which you can see the necessary filters. Table 3.1 covers variants of results recording. To set up a filter for inspection characteristics, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Results Recording  Define Filter for Inspection Char- acteristics. On the initial screen that appears, choose Transaction Code QA11, and Charc Filter 0, and the screen in Figure 3.114 appears with checkboxes to control the combina- tion of characteristics for display during results recording. Figure 3.114 Results Recording: Processing Modes 3 Quality Inspection 232 Make Settings for Operation Completion In this configuration, you control the combination of inspection type and plant that allows operation completion of an inspection lot. For the necessary operation completion settings, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Results Recording  Make Settings for Results Copy and Operation Completion. In Figure 3.115, you can make specific settings—for exam- ple, for Inspection type 89 for recurring inspections with plant selection. Further, you can also limit the option for the user to choose usage decision codes to the specific selected set, as well as a specific plant for the usage decision selected set. Finally, select- ing the UD Plant checkbox ensures that the usage decision codes for the selected set correspond to that specific plant only. Figure 3.115 Settings for Operation Completion Fields Selection You can control the fields in the SAP system for which entry is mandatory, optional, an input option, or hidden from display. For example, during the inspection plan creation, if you want the user to enter information in a specific field, you can select the Req. radio button. You can also control how the system prompts the user to perform any depen- dent function when the user enters information in one field. This option works when one modifiable field relates to the influencing fields. To control input or display of field © 233 3.6 Configuration Basics: Quality Planning and Quality Inspection selection, use menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality Planning  Engineer- ing Workbench  Engineering Workbench  Define Field Selection. For this example, let’s look at the task list header. In the popup that appears, choose PP/ PI/QM Task Lists: Header Screen, and the screen in Figure 3.116 appears. Here, notice the different available fields. You can change the necessary parameters, such as input-only, required, and optional. Notice that you have five options available in the modifiable fields:  Input The entry in this field is optional.  Req. (required) The entry in this field is mandatory.  Disp. (display) There is no entry because it’s available for display only.  Hide The system hides this field, so it isn’t displayed.  HiLi (highlight) Any specific field can be highlighted if you want the user to pay attention. For exam- ple, when marking a field entry as Req., you can also select the HiLi checkbox to enable the user to quickly see the fields requiring entries. Figure 3.116 Field Selection for PP-PI/QM Task List: Header Screens 3 Quality Inspection 234 Note Screen fields and groups are found in several other submenus of the QM area, but the basics covered in this section remain the same.
sections.he:
ניתן להקים catalogs ל-usage decisions (type 3). ליישום, צריך תחילה quality score procedure, ‏follow-up actions, ו-inventory postings.

**Define Quality Score Procedure:** ברירת מחדל ב-inspection type. ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality Inspection • Inspection Lot Completion • Define Quality Score Procedure. בחרו Q-Score Procedure 01 (Figure 3.108) — function module לחישוב. ‏Permitted Share of Scrap — אחוז פגמים מותר בחישוב. ‏Relevant Insp. Chars — אם תוצאות ה-MICs נשקלות (בעיקר אם סגורות והוערכו).

**Define Follow-Up Actions:** ל-... • Inspection Lot Completion • Define Follow-Up Actions for Usage Decisions • Follow-Up Actions (Figure 3.109). פעולות בשלבים (בעיקר usage decision) — ביטול ה-lot בדחייה, שליחת email למשתמשי SAP.

**Define Inventory Postings:** ב-usage decision — הקצאת קוד (חישוב scores) ו-posting (למבוסס-מלאי). ל-... • Inspection Lot Completion • Define Inventory Postings (Figure 3.110). סוגי התנועה כבר מוקצים — למשל העברת Q Stock To Scrap היא movement type 553. שמרו תקני אלא אם יצרתם סוג מותאם.

**Define Recording Configuration:** ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality Inspection • Results Recording • Define Recording Configuration (Recording Config. ‏Figure 3.111).

טבלה 3.9 — תצורת רישום (תיבה | פונקציה):
| Close on Continuing | סוגר את ה-MIC להזנה ב-Continue (Enter). |
| Close when Navigating | סוגר בניווט למסך אחר. |
| Autom. Close When Saving | סוגר בשמירה. |
| Autom. Save on Confirmation of Last Value | שמירה ויציאה אוטומטית בערך האחרון. |
| Goto to next char., partial sample, insp. unit | ניווט אוטומטי לבא. |
| Goto the next operation to be inspected | מעבר לפעולה הבאה. |
| Skip Characteristic Overview Screen | מבקש לשמור ולצאת במקום סקירה. |
| Single Values Not Automatically Expanded | אין שורות single נוספות אוטומטית. |
| Valuate on Enter | הערכה אוטומטית (accept/reject) בהזנה. |

**Define Origins of Results Data:** מקור הנתונים — תעודה אלקטרונית מספק, תוצאות ציוד בדיקה, הזנה ידנית. ל-... • Results Recording • Define Origin of Results Data.

**Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristics:** פרמטרי נוסחה לקלט מאפיינים מחושבים — ‏(1) הפניה ישירה לשדות; ‏(2) הפניה ל-function modules. למשל, הפרש בין ממוצעים — הפניה לשדות; מספר ערכים מעל יעד — function module (counting). ל-... • Results Recording • Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristics • Define Parameters for Calculated Characteristic (Parameter C0, ‏Figure 3.112 — שם השדה C0, ממוצע הערך הנמדד; ‏Use Function Module). ‏Assign Field Names to Parameters/Fields (Figure 3.113) — Table Name ו-Field: DB field.

**Define Filter for Inspection Characteristics:** ב-Transaction QE01, ‏Char. Filter — סינון התצוגה. ל-... • Results Recording • Define Filter for Inspection Characteristics (Transaction Code QA11, ‏Charc Filter 0, ‏Figure 3.114).

**Make Settings for Operation Completion:** בקרת צירוף type+מפעל המתיר השלמת פעולה. ל-... • Results Recording • Make Settings for Results Copy and Operation Completion (Figure 3.115 — type 89, ‏recurring). ‏UD Plant — קודי ה-usage decision תואמים למפעל בלבד.

**Fields Selection:** בקרת שדות (חובה/אופציונלי/קלט/מוסתר). ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality Planning • Engineering Workbench • Engineering Workbench • Define Field Selection • PP/PI/QM Task Lists: Header Screen (Figure 3.116). חמש אפשרויות: ‏Input (אופציונלי); ‏Req. (חובה); ‏Disp. (תצוגה); ‏Hide (מוסתר); ‏HiLi (הדגשה).

**הערת יועץ:** quality-inspection-config — catalog-type-3 (UD-codes), quality-score-procedure, follow-up-actions, inventory-postings. מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, שרשרת: UD-code → follow-up (מייל/סטטוס) + score (מזין vendor-eval/dynamic-mod) + posting. יועץ מנוסה מתכנן את-קטלוג-ה-UD עם-הלקוח (קודים-ברורים, follow-ups-אוטומטיים) — זו-שפת-ההחלטות היומית. ההבחנה score-procedure (איך-מחושב) מול-follow-up (מה-קורה). הבנת-ה-inspection-config חיונית — קובעת את-השלכות-כל-UD.

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 3.7 Summary Quality inspection entails following a series of business processes that record complete inspection results, record defects, and make usage decisions that may or may not include stock posting. When these business processes begin to mature and stabilize, you can optimize some or all of them by automating them to reduce or eliminate redundant data entry. Digital signature functionality brings greater business controls and transparency to business processes. Dynamic modification rules enable a com- pany to adjust quality levels based on the quality of products produced in house or materials delivered by suppliers. Multiple specifications functionality offers far greater flexibility in adapting to specific business needs of companies and span beyond a material’s customer or supplier assignment. The next chapter discusses how the QM functionality in SAP S/4HANA integrates with the materials management functionality. © PART II Quality Management Integration with Logistics ©
sections.he:
בדיקת איכות כוללת רישום תוצאות, רישום פגמים, ו-usage decisions (עם/בלי posting). בהתבגרות התהליכים, ניתן למטב באוטומציה (הפחתת כפילות). החתימה הדיגיטלית מביאה בקרה ושקיפות. ה-dynamic modification rules מתאימים רמות איכות לפי איכות הייצור/הספק. ה-multiple specifications מספק גמישות מעבר להקצאת לקוח/ספק. הפרק הבא — אינטגרציית QM עם MM.

לסיכום, בדיקת-איכות כרוכה בסדרת-תהליכים: תיעוד-תוצאות מלא, תיעוד-פגמים, וקבלת-usage-decisions הכוללות (או-לא) stock-posting. כשהתהליכים מבשילים-ומתייצבים, ניתן-לייעל חלק-מהם או-את-כולם באוטומציה המצמצמת הזנות-כפולות. ה-digital-signature מביאה בקרה-ושקיפות; ה-dynamic-modification מאפשר התאמת רמות-בדיקה לביצועי-איכות בפועל. עבור-היועץ, הפרק מספר סיפור-בשלות שלם: שלב-1 — התהליך-הבסיסי (lot→results→defects→UD→stock-posting) חייב-לרוץ-יציב; שלב-2 — אופטימיזציות (QS27, QAC1, העתקת-תוצאות, UD-קולקטיבי/אוטומטי, Engineering-Workbench) מצמצמות-עבודה; שלב-3 — יכולות-מתקדמות (digital-signature לרגולציה, multiple-specifications לריבוי-שווקים, dynamic-modification להתאמת-נטל, inspection-types מותאמים להפרדת-זרימות) עונות לצרכים-ייחודיים. ההבחנה בין-השלבים היא-מפת-דרכים ליישום: אל-תדלג — אוטומציה-על-תהליך-שבור משכפלת-שבירות. התצורה (3.6: client→plant→planning→inspection) היא-חדר-המכונות מאחורי-הכל. ⚠️ תוכן: QM, לא-EWM. הבנת-מכלול-בדיקת-האיכות חיונית — זהו-הלב-התפעולי של-QM היומיומי. הפרק-הבא ממשיך את-מסע-ה-QM אל-התחומים-הבאים.

**הערת יועץ וסיכום מורחב:** הפרק פרש את-בדיקת-האיכות כסיפור-בשלות: בסיס (lot→results→defects→UD→posting) → אופטימיזציות (QS27/QAC1/copy/collective+auto-UD/Workbench) → מתקדם (digital-signature, multiple-specs, dynamic-modification, types-מותאמים) → תצורה (client→plant→planning→inspection). עבור-היועץ, מפת-דרכים: אל-תדלג-שלבים — אוטומציה על-שבור משכפלת-שבירות. ⚠️ תוכן: QM, לא-EWM. הליבה: QA32/QE51N/QA11 = היומיום; dynamic-mod+auto-UD = החיסכון-הגדול; signature = הרגולציה. הבנת-המכלול חיונית — הלב-התפעולי של-QM. הפרק-הבא ממשיך.

sections.title: Configuration Basics
sections.en: 4.1 Configuration Basics Let’s begin with a configuration check to ensure that the material type-related settings are in place in SAP S/4HANA so that you can successfully integrate QM with MM.
sections.he:
נתחיל בבדיקת תצורה — שהגדרות סוג החומר במקומן לאינטגרציית QM עם MM.

נתחיל בבדיקת-תצורה לוודא שהגדרות-הקשורות-ל-material-type במקומן ב-S/4HANA, כדי-שניתן-יהיה לשלב-QM-עם-MM בהצלחה. עבור-היועץ, פרק-זה כולו עוסק בשילוב-QM-בשרשרת-הרכש-והמלאי (MM), ושני-תנאי-התצורה הבסיסיים כאן הם-השער: (1) צירוף-material-type/task-list — האם-סוג-החומר בכלל-יכול לשאת inspection-plan (task-list-type-Q); (2) ה-QM-control-key ברכש — איזה-כוח יש-ל-QM על-תהליך-הרכש (חסימת-תשלום, חובת-הסכם-איכות). ההבחנה בין-שני-הרכיבים מהותית: הראשון-מבני (מה-אפשרי), השני-התנהגותי (מה-נאכף). בלי-הצירוף — לא-ניתן-ליצור plan לחומר; בלי-control-key — ה-QM לא-אוכף-דבר ברכש. שני-אלה הם-תצורת-חובה לפני-כל-תרחישי-הפרק (GR-inspection, source, pilot, subcontracting). הבנת-יסודות-התצורה חיונית — הם-התשתית שכל-26-הסעיפים-הבאים נשענים-עליה. יועץ מנוסה בודק את-שניהם ב-checklist-פתיחה של-כל-פרויקט-QM-רכש, לפני-נגיעה בנתוני-אב, כי-כשל-כאן מתגלה-מאוחר כתקלות-סתומות (חומר-בלי-plan, רכש-שלא-נחסם).

**הערת יועץ:** config-basics QM-MM — שני-שערים: material-type↔task-list-Q (מבני — מה-אפשרי) + QM-control-key (התנהגותי — מה-נאכף). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, בלי-הצירוף אין-plan; בלי-key אין-אכיפה. יועץ מנוסה בודק שניהם ב-checklist-פתיחה, לפני-נתוני-אב. ההבחנה מבני מול-התנהגותי. כשל-כאן = תקלות-סתומות מאוחר. הבנת-היסודות חיונית — התשתית של-כל-הפרק.

נקודה-מתודולוגית לסיום: שני-שערי-התצורה הללו נבדלים גם-במיקום-התיקון — הצירוף material-type/task-list הוא-הגדרת-Customizing חד-פעמית שעוברת-ב-transport, בעוד-הקצאת-ה-control-key היא-נתון-אב (QM-view) המתוחזק-פר-חומר בכל-מערכת. לכן-בתקלה: צירוף-חסר מתקנים-ב-DEV-ומעבירים; key-חסר מתקנים-ישירות במאסטר. הפרדה-זו קובעת גם-מי-מטפל — צוות-התצורה מול-צוות-נתוני-האב — וחשוב-שהיא-תשתקף בחלוקת-האחריות של-פרויקט-היישום ובנוהלי-התחזוקה השוטפים שאחרי-ה-go-live.

sections.title: Material Type/Task List Combination
sections.en: 4.1.1 Material Type/Task List Combination If the company uses the standard material types, such as raw materials (ROH), finished goods (FERT), or trading goods (HAWA), then their task list types are available in the system. However, if any material type that you want to go through the quality inspec- tion and control process (e.g., spare parts [ERSA] or a company-specific material type) isn’t available, then you need to ensure that the combination of task list type Q with the material type exists in the system. To do so, follow configuration menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  QM Planning  Inspection Planning  Assign Task List Type to Material Type. Choose New Entries, add the material type/task list type combination, and then save your entries.
sections.he:
אם משתמשים בסוגי חומר תקניים (ROH גלם, ‏FERT גמור, ‏HAWA סחר), ה-task list types זמינים. אם סוג שיעבור בדיקה (ERSA חלפים, או ספציפי-חברה) אינו זמין — ודאו שצירוף task list type Q עם הסוג קיים. ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • QM Planning • Inspection Planning • Assign Task List Type to Material Type. ‏New Entries, הוסיפו את הצירוף, שמרו.

אם-החברה משתמשת ב-material-types סטנדרטיים — raw-materials (ROH), finished-goods (FERT), או-trading-goods (HAWA) — סוגי-ה-task-list שלהם זמינים-במערכת. אולם, אם-material-type שרוצים-להעביר בתהליך-בדיקת-איכות (למשל, spare-parts [ERSA] או-סוג-ספציפי-לחברה) אינו-זמין, יש-לוודא שצירוף-task-list-type-Q עם-ה-material-type קיים במערכת, דרך-תצורה. עבור-היועץ, זהו-שער-כניסה שקט: הצירוף material-type↔task-list-type-Q קובע האם-בכלל-ניתן ליצור-inspection-plan לחומרים-מסוג-זה. הסטנדרטיים (ROH/FERT/HAWA) מגיעים-מוכנים; החריגים (ERSA, סוגי-Z-מותאמים) לא — וללא-הצירוף, QP01 פשוט-ייכשל או-שהחומר-לא-יעבור-בדיקות. ההבחנה בין-סוגים-מכוסים-מראש לסוגים-הדורשים-תצורה מהותית: פרויקטים-רבים מגלים-מאוחר שחומרי-חלפים (ERSA) שהוחלט-לבדוק אינם-נתמכים — תיקון-פשוט אך-מעכב. הבנת-הצירוף חיונית — הוא-קובע את-תחולת-ה-QM ברמת-סוג-החומר, לפני-כל-הגדרה-פרטנית. יועץ מנוסה סורק בתחילת-הפרויקט את-כל-ה-material-types שבשימוש-הלקוח מול-טבלת-הצירופים, ומשלים את-החסרים ב-transport אחד מסודר.

**הערת יועץ:** material-type/task-list — ROH/FERT/HAWA מוכנים; ERSA/Z-types דורשים-תצורה (צירוף עם-type-Q). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, בלי-הצירוף QP01 נכשל / החומר לא-נבדק. יועץ מנוסה סורק את-כל-ה-material-types של-הלקוח מול-הטבלה בתחילת-הפרויקט, משלים ב-transport אחד. ההבחנה מכוסה-מראש מול-דורש-תצורה. מלכודת-חלפים (ERSA) קלאסית. הבנת-הצירוף חיונית — תחולת-QM ברמת-סוג-חומר.

sections.title: Control Key for Quality Management in Procurement
sections.en: 4.1.2 Control Key for Quality Management in Procurement The QM control key plays a crucial role in meeting the business needs of a company. For example, using control keys in procurement, you can block supplier payments or all supplier activities until delivered goods clear the quality control process. After mak- ing the necessary configuration settings for the QM control key, you need to assign it in the QM view of the material master, which we’ll cover in Section 4.2.1. To define a QM control key, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  QM in Logistics  QM in Procurement  Define Control Keys. Choose QM Control Key “0007”, and Figure 4.1 appears. Table 4.2 provides the detailed function of each field. 0102 52 Goods receipt inspection for source inspection 0130 53 Goods receipt inspection at goods receipt from external processing 05 5 Inspection for other goods receipts 08 5 Stock transfer inspection 0800 5 Inspection lot with inspection stock already avail- able at the time of QM activation Inspection Type Inspection Plan Usage Inspection Type Description Table 4.1 Inspection Types in Procurement and Inventory Management (Cont.) © 239 4.1 Configuration Basics Figure 4.1 QM Control Key Field Details Document Control Tech. Delivery Terms (technical delivery terms) Requires that the technical delivery terms exist in Docu- ment Management System (DMS). DMS is covered in Chapter 20. Use Transaction QV01 to create a new qual- ity agreement document. Select document type Q02, and enter the material number in the Objects Link tab. Q-Agreement Reqd (quality agreement required) Requires that the quality agreement exists in DMS. Use Transaction QV01 to create a new quality agreement document. Select document type Q01, and enter the material, plant, and supplier combination in the Objects Link tab. Table 4.2 Control Parameters of QM Control Key 4 Integrating with Materials Management 240 QM Control in Procurement Release Required Requires that a quality information record exists before procurement can begin. Certificate Required Requires the supplier to submit a certificate at the time the goods are delivered. Block Inactive Makes all kinds of blocks ineffective. Block Invoice Invoice remains blocked until the goods are quality cleared. Message Control for Lock Message Mode Based on the setting here (information, warning, or error), SAP issues a message when a supplier block is in place. GR/Source Inspection Control GR for Rejection (goods receipt for rejection) A control function that’s triggered when the company rejects a supplier’s material at the source inspection level. In Figure 4.1 1, choose the option to create a new inspection lot on goods receipt and when material is rejected during source inspection. Further, you’ll see this business process in Section 4.2.2. GR Control/Batch (goods receipt control/batch) The system checks for consistency between a supplier’s batch number created or available during source inspec- tion with the batch number at the time of goods receipt. If there is any inconsistency, the system can either create a new inspection lot on goods receipt or use the original inspection lot number from the source inspection. In Figure 4.1 2, choose the option for the system not to create a new inspection lot on goods receipt of a mate- rial’s batch. FAI Plan Usage (first article inspection plan usage) First article inspection for the production part approval process is a new feature in SAP S/4HANA to provide bet- ter quality control for material supplied by a supplier, which will eventually be used in production processes. The first article inspection for the production part approval process options in dropdown of Figure 4.1 3 are shown in Figure 4.2. We’ll also discuss the associated business process in Section 4.3. Field Details Table 4.2 Control Parameters of QM Control Key (Cont.) © 241
sections.he:
ה-QM control key קריטי. למשל, חוסם תשלומי ספק או כל פעילות עד שהסחורה עוברת בקרה. לאחר התצורה, מקצים אותו בתצוגת QM של אב החומר (4.2.1).
להגדרה: SAP IMG • Quality Management • QM in Logistics • QM in Procurement • Define Control Keys. בחרו QM Control Key "0007" (Figure 4.1).
(טבלה 4.1 — סוגי בדיקה ברכש/IM: ‏0102 [usage 52] GR source inspection; ‏0130 [53] GR מ-external processing; ‏05 [5] GRs אחרים; ‏08 [5] stock transfer; ‏0800 [5] lot עם inspection stock בהפעלת QM.)

טבלה 4.2 — פרמטרי ה-QM control key:
**Document Control:**
| **Tech. Delivery Terms** | דורש תנאי משלוח טכניים ב-DMS (פרק 20). ‏Transaction QV01, סוג מסמך Q02, הזינו חומר ב-Objects Link. |
| **Q-Agreement Reqd** | דורש quality agreement ב-DMS. ‏Transaction QV01, סוג Q01, צירוף חומר/מפעל/ספק. |
**QM Control in Procurement:**
| **Release Required** | דורש quality information record לפני רכש. |
| **Certificate Required** | דורש תעודה מהספק באספקה. |
| **Block Inactive** | מבטל את כל החסימות. |
| **Block Invoice** | החשבונית חסומה עד אישור הסחורה. |
**Message Control for Lock:**
| **Message Mode** | information/warning/error בחסימת ספק. |
**GR/Source Inspection Control:**
| **GR for Rejection** | מופעל בדחיית חומר ב-source inspection. ‏(Figure 4.1) — יצירת lot חדש ב-GR ובדחייה (4.2.2). |
| **GR Control/Batch** | בדיקת עקביות בין מספר אצוות ה-source inspection ל-GR; ביצירת lot חדש או שימוש במקורי. |
| **FAI Plan Usage** | first article inspection ל-production part approval process — תכונה חדשה (Figure 4.2; ‏4.3). |

ה-QM-control-key ממלא תפקיד-מכריע במענה לצורכי-העסק: באמצעות control-keys ברכש ניתן-לחסום תשלומי-ספק או-את-כל-פעילויות-הספק עד-שהסחורה עוברת בקרת-איכות. לאחר-הגדרות-התצורה, מקצים את-ה-control-key ב-QM-view של-מאסטר-החומר. להגדרה: menu-path (SAP-IMG • Quality-Management • QM-in-Logistics • Procurement). עבור-היועץ, ה-control-key הוא-'עוצמת-האכיפה' של-QM-ברכש: הוא-קובע אילו-בקרות חלות על-חומר-נרכש — חסימת-invoice עד-אישור-איכות (block-invoice), דרישת-הסכם-איכות-תקף (QA-agreement-required), דרישת-quality-info-record, ועוד — בשילובים-שונים. ההבחנה בין-רמות-האכיפה מהותית: control-key רך (רק-תיעוד) מול-קשיח (חסימת-תשלום בפועל) — הבחירה היא-החלטה-עסקית עם-השלכות על-יחסי-ספקים ותזרים. חסימת-ה-invoice היא-הכלי-החזק-ביותר: הספק לא-מקבל-כסף עד-שהאיכות-מאושרת — תמריץ-אמיתי. ההקצאה במאסטר (QM-view) הופכת את-המדיניות לפר-חומר: חומרים-קריטיים מקבלים key-קשיח, שוליים — רך. הבנת-ה-control-key חיונית — הוא-שהופך את-ה-QM מגוף-מתעד לגוף-אוכף בשרשרת-הרכש. יועץ מנוסה מגדיר מדרג-keys (קשיח/בינוני/רך) ומקצה לפי-קריטיות-החומר, בתיאום-עם-רכש-וכספים (החסימות-נוגעות-בהם ישירות).

**הערת יועץ:** QM-control-key — עוצמת-האכיפה ברכש: invoice-block עד-אישור-איכות, חובת-QA-agreement/QI-record. מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, מוקצה ב-QM-view פר-חומר. יועץ מנוסה בונה מדרג (קשיח/בינוני/רך) לפי-קריטיות + מתאם עם-רכש-וכספים. ההבחנה key-רך (מתעד) מול-קשיח (חוסם-תשלום — תמריץ-אמיתי). הבנת-ה-key חיונית — הופך-QM ממתעד לאוכף. הכלי-הכספי החזק-ביותר של-האיכות.

sections.title: Procurement Business Processes
sections.en: 4.2 Procurement Business Processes Figure 4.2 First Article Inspection Plan Usage 4.2 Procurement Business Processes Let’s now delve into the various business processes of procurement and IM. Each sec- tion will provide an overview of the integrated QM and MM business processes, detail the master data checklist, and then provide more details.
sections.he:
להלן תהליכי הרכש וה-IM — סקירה, רשימת נתוני אב, ופרטים.

כעת-נצלול לתהליכי-העסק השונים של-רכש-ו-inventory-management. כל-סעיף יספק סקירה של-תהליכי-ה-QM-MM המשולבים, יפרט את-checklist-נתוני-האב, ואז-ירחיב. עבור-היועץ, מבנה-הסעיפים הוא-מתודולוגיה-בפני-עצמה: לכל-תרחיש-רכש (GR-רגיל, source, FAI, pilot, subcontracting) — קודם-התהליך (מה-קורה), אחר-כך-checklist-האב (מה-חייב-להיות-מוגדר), ואז-הפירוט (איך-בפועל). זו-גם-דרך-העבודה הנכונה ביישום: להבין-תהליך → לוודא-אב → להריץ. מפת-התרחישים של-הפרק לפי-inspection-types: 01 (GR-מרכש — הליבה), 0101 (source — אצל-הספק, לפני-משלוח), 0102 (pilot-run — הסמכת-ספק-חדש), 0130 (subcontracting — קבלנות-משנה), 08 (stock-transfer), 05 (GR-אחר, ללא-PO), 0800 (QM-activation על-מלאי-קיים). ההבחנה בין-ה-types היא-הבחנה-בין-אירועים-עסקיים: כל-type נקשר-לאירוע-רכש/מלאי אחר ויוצר-lot בהתאם. הבנת-המפה חיונית — היא-שמאפשרת לבחור לכל-תרחיש-לקוח את-ה-type הנכון ואת-שרשרת-האב הנכונה. יועץ מנוסה משתמש במפה-הזו כ-blueprint: עובר-עם-הלקוח תרחיש-תרחיש ומסמן אילו-types מופעלים.

**הערת יועץ:** procurement-processes — מפת-types: 01 (GR), 0101 (source), 0102 (pilot), 0130 (subcontracting), 08 (transfer), 05 (ללא-PO), 0800 (activation). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, כל-type = שער בנקודת-סיכון אחרת. יועץ מנוסה עובר עם-הלקוח תרחיש-תרחיש ומסמן types. מבנה-הסעיפים (תהליך→checklist→פירוט) = גם-מתודולוגיית-היישום. הבנת-המפה חיונית — bluepr int לבחירת-שערים ללקוח.

הערה-מעשית על-סדר-הלימוד: מומלץ-לשלוט-תחילה בתרחיש-01 (הליבה) על-כל-שלביו — כי-כל-שאר-ה-types חולקים את-אותו-שלד (lot→results→UD→posting) ונבדלים רק-בטריגר וב-usage. מי-שמבין את-01 לעומק ילמד כל-type-נוסף בדקות: השאלות-הקבועות הן-תמיד מה-מפעיל את-ה-lot, איזה-usage מושך את-ה-plan, ומה-דין-המלאי. גישה-זו מקצרת-הדרכות ומפשטת-תיעוד — מסמך-ליבה-אחד ותוספות-קצרות פר-תרחיש, במקום-שבעה-מסמכים-מלאים.

sections.title: Goods Receipt in Procurement: Inspection Type 01
sections.en: 4.2.1 Goods Receipt in Procurement: Inspection Type 01 Figure 4.3 shows a commonly used business process in which a standard procurement process integrates with QM. This process begins with creating a purchase order for a supplier to deliver the material. As soon as the company records the goods receipt with reference to the purchase order, the system creates an inspection lot. Standard QM pro- cesses, such as results recording, occur, followed by usage decisions and stock posting. On quality clearance of goods, the supplier submits the invoice for payment. Figure 4.3 QM Integration into Procurement Process In the next sections, you’ll either set up the master data required for this business pro- cess or check that the relevant master data exists. Upon ensuring master data availabil- ity, you’ll see impacts of configuration and master data setup on business processes. Purchase order/ scheduling agreement Goods receipt QM inspection lot Invoice receipt 4 Integrating with Materials Management 242 QM Master Data Checklist The following is the QM master data checklist:  Inspection type 01 active in the QM view of the material master  Inspection plan usage 5 (for goods receipt) and status 4 (for released)  Quality information record Now, let’s look at the important settings you need to make in the QM master data to ensure assignment of not only control key 0007 but also the source inspection busi- ness process (inspection type 0101), which we’ll cover in Section 4.2.2. Quality Management View in Material Master Use Transaction MM01 (see Figure 4.4) to select the QM in Procur. Active checkbox if you need a quality information record to exist when creating a purchase order. Select- ing this checkbox also entails assigning the previously configured QM Control Key, which controls the allowed (or disallowed) functions. For this example, assign the QM Control Key “0007”, and save the settings. Figure 4.4 QM Control Key in the Material Master Quality Information Record Revisiting Figure 4.4, we selected the QM Procur. Active checkbox. Now in this step, you define a relationship from a material to a supplier as a part of QM master data. This rela- tionship is called a quality information record: procurement. © 243 4.2 Procurement Business Processes To create a quality information record, use Transaction QI01 or follow menu path Logistics  Quality Management  Quality Planning  Logistics Master Data  Quality Info Record: Procurement  Create. On the initial screen, enter Material “QM003”, Supplier “EWM17-SU01”, and Plant “1710”, and the screen in Figure 4.5 appears. We define the Release Until date, which is the last date that the supplier can supply the material. The Release Qty Active checkbox verifies that only procurement orders up to the released quantity you define are placed with the supplier, before the company reviews this rela- tionship (quality information record) again. Figure 4.5 Quality Information Record Tips and Tricks If the supplier in question is a regular supplier who will continue to supply a much larger quantity of material over a longer period of time, you can deselect the Release Qty Active checkbox. Similarly, if you don’t need to restrict the quantity of material that the supplier can supply, you don’t have to enter any quantity in the Release Quan- tity field. In the Inspection Control tab shown in Figure 4.6, assign Source Inspection type “0101”, which stipulates the source inspection for the supplier. The lead time (in days) is 4 Integrating with Materials Management 244 important because the system uses it to calculate the date when the source inspection is due at the supplier. Realistic and practical information in this field greatly helps in ensuring a timely source inspection. Selecting the Source Insp. - No GR checkbox is a control function that ensures that the system doesn’t create an inspection lot at the time of goods receipt in the company’s own warehouse. As noted earlier, first article inspection for the production part approval process is a new feature in SAP S/4HANA to provide better quality control for material supplied by supplier, which will eventually be used in production processes. As already mentioned, we also discuss the associated business process in Section 4.3, including the dropdown options for the PPAP Status field that are only available in the Manage Quality Info Records app (and not in SAP GUI). Figure 4.6 Inspection Control In this screen, assign Status Profile “QM_P_001”, which is available in standard SAP; we’ll explain its importance and how it works in Section 4.4.1. The Quality Agreement tab enables assigning the quality agreement with the supplier, which we covered in Chapter 2. Save the quality information record. © 245 4.2 Procurement Business Processes With the master data settings complete, let’s now initiate the procurement process and see how QM integrates with it. Purchase Order Create a purchase order for the same material and supplier for which you just created the quality information record with Transaction ME21N, or follow menu path Logistics  Materials Management  Purchasing  Purchase Order  Create  Supplier/Supplying Plant Known. In the screen in Figure 4.7, enter Supplier “EWM17-SU01”, Material “QM003”, PO Quan- tity “100” PC, Net Price of “10.00” USD, and plant (Plnt) “1710” (not shown). Save the pur- chase order; the system creates purchase order number 4500001837. Figure 4.7 Purchase Order Note Apart from the purchase order, if the business process entails using a scheduling agreement or contract release order (from a quantity or a value contract) against which the company procures goods from a supplier, then the following steps still remain the same. 4 Integrating with Materials Management 246 Goods Receipt for Purchase Order The supplier delivers the material that is ordered against purchase order number 4500001837, and the warehouse supervisor records its goods receipt. Access the screen in Figure 4.8 via Transaction MIGO, or follow menu path Logistics  Materials Manage- ment  Inventory Management  Goods Movement  Goods Movement. Choose Goods Receipt and then Purchase Order from the dropdown lists at the top. Figure 4.8 Goods Receipt for Purchase Order Enter purchase order number “4500001837”. The movement type for goods receipt against a purchase order is 101 and is shown at the top-right corner of the screen. If it’s a batch-managed material, then the system creates a batch number and receives the stock as Quality Inspection stock. Saving your entries creates inspection lot 10000000666, as shown in Figure 4.9. Note You can integrate incoming quality certificates in your procurement processes either via manual recording or through Electronic Data Interchange (EDI). Refer to Chapter 11 on incoming quality certificates. © 247 4.2 Procurement Business Processes Tips and Tricks As soon as you record the goods receipt for a purchase order, the system creates both a material and an accounting document. This means the company is liable to pay the supplier for the delivered goods, unless the goods are rejected and returned to the sup- plier. If there’s any unique business need, the system shouldn’t create an accounting document (and book liabilities) until goods are quality cleared; then, you can use movement type 103 (for GR Blocked Stock) for this scenario, as shown in Figure 4.8. On usage decision and stock posting, the system uses movement type 105 to Release GR Blocked Stock. Quality Management Inspection Lot for Goods Receipt against Purchase Orders Figure 4.9 shows the inspection lot (Transaction QA03) that the system creates on goods receipt inspection for a purchase order. The inspection type is 01 and consists of all the relevant details, including purchase order number 4500001837. The next three steps are routine QM business process steps: results recording, usage decision, and stock posting. Perform all these steps, and proceed to record the supplier invoice. Figure 4.9 Goods Receipt Inspection Lot 4 Integrating with Materials Management 248 Invoice Receipt You can post and release the supplier invoice for the delivered quantity of material after the goods are quality checked with reference to the same purchase order. To post a supplier invoice, use Transaction MIRO or follow menu path Logistics  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Document Entry  Enter Invoice (see Figure 4.10). Click the Basic Data tab, and enter data for the purchase order document number, invoice date, reference, amount, and tax data. Save your entry, and the system issues an invoice number and a warning message to inform you that the invoice is blocked for payment (see Figure 4.11). This is because you’ve made relevant settings (back in Figure 4.1) that stipulate blocking the supplier invoice until the stock is quality cleared. Figure 4.10 Invoice Receipt Figure 4.11 Blocked Invoice To release the invoice so that you can pay the supplier for the delivered material, use Transaction MRBR or follow menu path Logistics  Materials Management  Logistics Invoice Verification  Document Entry  Enter Invoice. Enter the invoice document num- ber, and run the report. The system shows the details report, from which you can select the relevant line item; choose Release to release the invoice. © 249 4.2 Procurement Business Processes

sections.title: Source Inspection: Inspection Type 0101
sections.en: 4.2.2 Source Inspection: Inspection Type 0101 Source inspection in QM ensures that the quality of procured goods is checked and approved for compliance before the supplier delivers the goods at the company’s ware- house. In source inspection, the supplier can then immediately deal with any defects in a product’s quality. The company can use this functionality to track when source inspec- tion needs to occur and carry it out. This saves the time that otherwise would be lost if the defective goods were delivered by the supplier and rejected (or asked to be reworked) by the company. You can quickly set up source inspection functionality to bring about sig- nificant overall process improvements and optimization to reduce the overall lead time incurred in ensuring that only quality goods are delivered by the supplier. You can implement source inspection at any time, even after an SAP S/4HANA system and the QM functionality are already implemented in a company. The option to inte- grate source inspection in the procurement process can be part of ongoing improve- ments and optimization in business processes in general and the procurement process in particular. For source inspection, create a purchase order so that you can see the importance of the delivery date and how source inspection takes it into account. Then, create an inspection lot by manually triggering the source inspection program. Record the results and make a usage decision about the goods by rejecting them, so that on goods receipt from the supplier and against the same purchase order, the system creates a new inspection lot. All of these settings are the direct result of configuration settings that we made in QM Control Key (see Figure 4.12). Figure 4.12 Source Inspection in Procurement Process Let’s go over these processes in detail in the following sections. QM Master Data Checklist The following is the QM master data checklist:  Inspection type 0101 active in QM view of material master  Quality information record: procurement  Inspection plan usage 51 and status 4 (for released) Next, we’ll go through the process of creating a purchase order, followed by manually triggering the source inspection that results in the creation of the inspection lot. Purchase order Source inspection Goods receipt QM inspection lot Invoice receipt 4 Integrating with Materials Management 250 Purchase Order Refer to Figure 4.7 once again. In the purchase order, the important field is the Delivery Date (February 29, 2024). For business processes in source inspection, the system con- siders the delivery date to evaluate the materials for which source inspections are due and within the opening date. Save the purchase order, and the system creates purchase order number 4500001838 in this example. Source Inspections Worklist To regularly monitor all materials for which a source inspection is due, you can trigger the creation of an inspection lot either manually or automatically via a batch input pro- gram. To trigger creation of inspection lots manually, use Transaction QI07 or follow menu path Logistics  Quality Management  Quality Inspection  Inspection Lot Cre- ation  Source Inspection  Trigger Manually. Figure 4.13 shows the initial screen for cre- ating source list inspection lots. You can define the relevant parameters here, and the ensuing worklist includes the relevant inspection lots. Figure 4.13 Initial Screen for the Source Inspections Worklist Enter Supplier “EWM17-SU01”, Material “QM003”, and Plant “1710”. You should also specify that all materials slated for delivery starting from February 29, 2024, and for the 30-day opening period be available in the worklist. The Inspect W/o Batch checkbox also takes into account the materials that aren’t batch-managed. Choose Execute (not shown), which leads to the worklist of the source inspection. In the screen in Figure 4.14, select the line item, and choose More  Inspection Lot. The system automatically creates an inspection lot for the source inspection, which in this example is 10000000667, as shown in Figure 4.15. Note To trigger the source inspection worklist automatically, use Transaction QA51. Create a variant, and then schedule the source inspection lot creation frequency. © 251 4.2 Procurement Business Processes Figure 4.14 Worklist of Source Inspections Figure 4.15 Source Inspection Type 0101 Results Recording and the Usage Decision of the Source Inspection Lot We record the results for this inspection lot with the purpose of rejecting the inspec- tion lot. Figure 4.16 shows the usage decision (Transaction QA11) in which you reject inspection lot 10000000667 by assigning the UD Code “R” and saving your work. 4 Integrating with Materials Management 252 Figure 4.16 Usage Decision to Reject the Inspection Lot Goods Receipt of Source-Inspected Material Figure 4.17 shows the goods receipt against the same purchase order 45000001838, in which the system doesn’t allow the goods receipt if the inspection lot of the source inspection has been rejected, thereby reflecting the configuration settings made using control key 0007 (refer to Figure 4.1). Figure 4.17 Goods Receipt Not Allowed © 253

source inspection מבטיח בדיקת איכות ואישור לפני שהספק מספק. הספק מטפל מיד בפגמים — חיסכון בזמן שאבד באספקת סחורה פגומה. ניתן ליישם בכל עת. הזמנה (לראות את חשיבות תאריך המשלוח) → יצירת lot בהפעלה ידנית → רישום ו-usage decision בדחייה → ב-GR, המערכת יוצרת lot חדש (לפי control key 0007; ‏Figure 4.12).
(זרימה: Purchase order → Source inspection → Goods receipt → QM inspection lot → Invoice receipt.)
**רשימת נתוני אב:**
• inspection type 0101 פעיל.
• quality information record: procurement.
• inspection plan usage 51, ‏status 4.

**הזמנה:** (Figure 4.7) — השדה החשוב Delivery Date (29/02/2024). המערכת שוקלת אותו להערכת source inspections. שמרו (4500001838).
**Source Inspections Worklist:** לניטור, ניתן ידני או אוטומטי (batch input). ידני: Transaction QI07 או Logistics • Quality Management • Quality Inspection • Inspection Lot Creation • Source Inspection • Trigger Manually (Figure 4.13). הזינו Supplier "EWM17-SU01", ‏Material "QM003", ‏Plant "1710", אספקה מ-29/02/2024 ו-opening period 30 ימים. ‏Inspect W/o Batch — גם לא-מנוהלי-אצווה. ‏Execute. ב-Figure 4.14, בחרו שורה, ‏More • Inspection Lot — נוצר lot (10000000667, ‏Figure 4.15).
**הערה:** אוטומטית — Transaction QA51 (variant + תזמון).
**רישום ו-usage decision:** במטרה לדחות. Figure 4.16 (Transaction QA11) — דחו lot 10000000667 ב-UD Code "R", שמרו.
**GR של חומר source-inspected:** Figure 4.17 — מול הזמנה 4500001838, המערכת אינה מתירה GR אם ה-lot של ה-source inspection נדחה (לפי control key 0007, ‏Figure 4.1).

ה-source-inspection ב-QM מבטיח שאיכות-הסחורה-הנרכשת נבדקת-ומאושרת לתאימות לפני-שהספק מספק את-הסחורה למחסן-החברה; הספק יכול-לטפל-מיד בפגמי-איכות. החברה עוקבת מתי-נדרשת source-inspection ומבצעת-אותה — חיסכון-זמן שאחרת-היה-אובד אם-סחורה-פגומה הייתה-מסופקת-ונדחית. שאר-תהליכי-ה-QM זהים: results (QE01), UD (QA11). עבור-היועץ, ה-source-inspection (type-0101) מזיזה את-שער-האיכות במעלה-הזרם — מהמחסן-שלי אל-רצפת-הספק: הבודק נוסע-לספק (או-הספק-מדווח), הבדיקה-מתבצעת לפני-משלוח, וסחורה-פגומה כלל-לא-יוצאת-לדרך. ההבחנה בין-source (לפני-משלוח, אצל-הספק, חוסך-שינוע-כפול) ל-GR-inspection (בקבלה, אצלי, תופס-בדיעבד) מהותית כלכלית: בפריטים-יקרים/כבדים/דחופים, דחייה-בשער עולה-הרבה (שינוע-חזרה, עיכוב-ייצור) — source משתלמת. המנגנון: lead-time של-source-inspection במאסטר קובע מתי-להפעיל את-ה-lot לפני-מועד-האספקה המתוכנן; UD-מאשרת יכולה אף-לפטור מבדיקת-GR חוזרת (לפי-תצורה). הבנת-ה-source-inspection חיונית — היא-כלי-מניעה קלאסי: להזיז-איכות-שמאלה (shift-left). יועץ מנוסה מפעיל source לספקים-חדשים/בעייתיים ולפריטים-קריטיים, ומשלב-אותה במסלול-ההסמכה יחד-עם-pilot-run (4.4).

**הערת יועץ:** source-inspection 0101 — שער-איכות אצל-הספק, לפני-משלוח (shift-left). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, lead-time במאסטר קובע מתי-נוצר-ה-lot לפני-אספקה; UD יכולה-לפטור מ-GR-חוזר. יועץ מנוסה מפעיל לספקים-חדשים/בעייתיים ופריטים-יקרים/כבדים (דחייה-בשער = שינוע-כפול יקר). ההבחנה source (מונע-משלוח-פגום) מול-GR (תופס-בדיעבד). חלק-ממסלול-הסמכה עם-pilot. הבנת-ה-source חיונית — מניעה-במקור.

sections.title: First Article Inspection for Production Part Approval Process
sections.en: 4.3 First Article Inspection for Production Part Approval Process The remaining QM business processes for source inspection are the same:  Record results for source inspection (Transaction QE01)  Usage decision (Transaction QA11) Invoice Receipt The business process of the invoice receipt is the same as we previously covered in Sec- tion 4.2.1. 4.3 First Article Inspection for Production Part Approval Process SAP has introduced first article inspection for the production part approval process to cater to the quality control and quality assurance needs of industries, such as automo- tive, aerospace, and so on to ensure comprehensive pre-inspection of underproduction products by a company. It’s an alternate to pilot run inspection, which we’ll discuss in Section 4.4. A model inspection is used to identify and rectify quality issues beforehand prior to the production of remaining products. The first article inspection for the pro- duction part approval process is a new feature in SAP S/4HANA and can be easily set up as long as the necessary configuration, master data, and business processes are put in place that enable effectively reporting for timely and informed business decisions. Once the supplier has passed the quality process of first article inspection for the production part approval process for the material to be supplied to the company, then the regular quality inspection can take place. As needed, first article inspection for the production part approval process can also be reinitiated to begin the reevaluation of a supplier. Figure 4.18 shows the end-to-end business processes for first article inspection for pro- duction part approval. In the business process, the first step is to make the relevant set- ting in the quality info record, which is relevant for first article approval for production part approval. This is then followed by the regular procure-to-pay process (purchase to goods receipt), and the goods receipt will generate an inspection lot of type 01 (goods receipt inspection for purchase order) associated to standard inspection plan usage 51 (goods receipt model inspection). Figure 4.18 Business Process of First Article Inspection for the Production Part Approval Process Let’s discuss the configuration settings followed by the business process of first article inspection for the production part approval process: Update Quality Info Record Purchase Order Goods Receipt Quality Insp. Lot Insp. Plan Usage 51 Results Recording Usage Decision 4 Integrating with Materials Management 254 1. The first prerequisite is to define a specific inspection plan usage (first article inspec- tion usage) for first article inspection in the control key for QM in procurement. To perform the necessary configuration, follow the menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  QM in Logistics  QM in Procurement  Define Control Keys for QM in Procurement. Define the FAI plan usage 51 (goods receipt model). We suggest that you quickly refer to control key settings we made in Section 4.1.2 and how control key 0007 was then assigned to the material master. 2. Maintain a quality info record (Transaction QI01) for the material (QM004) and sup- plier (EWM17-SU01) combination. In the Inspection Control tab of the quality info record, choose the PPAP Required checkbox followed by choosing New from the PPAP Status dropdown in Figure 4.19. Save your settings. Figure 4.19 PPA in Quality Info Record 3. Maintain two inspection plans (usage 51 and usage 5) for the material using Transac- tion QP01. 4. The quality planning of first article inspections for purchase orders can only be undertaken using the Manage Quality Info Records app (see Figure 4.20), as the clas- sical SAP GUI Transactions QI01 and QI02 don’t completely support this feature. 5. As we’ve just created the quality info record of the material-supplier-plant combina- tion using Transaction QI01, it’s now available in Figure 4.20. 6. Use the forward arrow located on the far-right side of the screen, so that Figure 4.21 appears. © 255 4.3 First Article Inspection for Production Part Approval Process Figure 4.20 Manage Quality Info Records App 7. The Inspection Control tab shown in Figure 4.21 will enable you to maintain the rele- vant production part approval process details, including production part approval process level and production part approval process status. 8. Choose the PPAP Level, for example, Warrant Only, followed by setting the PPAP sta- tus as In Process to initiate the first article inspection for the production part approval process. Figure 4.21 Quality Info Record: Detailed Screen 4 Integrating with Materials Management 256 9. Choose Add in Figure 4.22 to assign the purchase order line items that are relevant for first article inspection. This purchase order of material-supplier-plant combina- tion should already be created in the system, so this assignment is made possible here. For this example, Purchasing Document “4500001843” and its line Item “10” is assigned. The valuation code shown as Not valuated is due to the fact that the usage decision isn’t yet taken because an inspection lot will only be created when posting the goods receipt takes place for the corresponding purchase order line item. Figure 4.22 Purchase Orders Relevant for First Article Inspection for the PPA Process 10. Post goods receipt for this purchase order using Transaction MIGO, and as shown in Figure 4.23, the system creates an inspection lot for goods receipt (Inspection Type 01) and assigns this inspection lot the Usage 51. 11. After results recordings and setting the usage decision, the status of the inspection lot will be displayed in the quality info record, so the quality inspector can com- plete the production part approval process by changing the PPAP Status field to Completed (see Figure 4.24). Note The system gives a warning at the time of usage decision for the inspection lot to inform the quality inspector that the first article inspection isn’t yet valuated and therefore will eventually impact the supplier qualification to regularly supply the material. © 257 4.3 First Article Inspection for Production Part Approval Process Figure 4.23 Inspection Lot for Goods Receipt with Inspection Usage Assigned as 51 Figure 4.24 Production Part Approval Process Status Marked as Completed 4 Integrating with Materials Management 258 Now that we’ve discussed the new feature, first article inspection for the production part approval process, let’s discuss a similar (and overlapping) feature of run pilot inspection in the next section. It’s important to note here that a company can only use one at a time: either first article inspection for the production part approval process or run pilot inspection business process (and not both).

5. ה-record (מ-QI01) זמין ב-Figure 4.20.
6. חץ קדימה (Figure 4.21).
7. בלשונית Inspection Control — תחזקו PPAP level ו-status.
8. בחרו PPAP Level (למשל Warrant Only), וקבעו PPAP status ל-In Process.
9. בחרו Add (Figure 4.22) להקצאת שורות ההזמנה ל-FAI (ההזמנה כבר נוצרה). בדוגמה, ‏Purchasing Document "4500001843", ‏Item "10". ה-valuation Not valuated כי ה-usage decision טרם התקבל (lot נוצר רק ב-GR).
10. רשמו GR (Transaction MIGO) — המערכת יוצרת lot ל-GR (type 01) עם Usage 51 (Figure 4.23).
11. לאחר רישום ו-usage decision, הסטטוס מוצג ב-record; הבודק משלים בשינוי PPAP Status ל-Completed (Figure 4.24).
**הערה:** המערכת מתריעה ב-usage decision שה-FAI טרם הוערך (ישפיע על הסמכת הספק).
ניתן רק אחד בכל עת — FAI ל-PPAP או run pilot inspection (לא שניהם).

**הערת יועץ:** FAI/PPAP — first-article-inspection לאישור-חלק-ייצור (דרישת automotive/aerospace). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, plan-usage ייעודי ל-FAI; הדגם-הראשון נבדק-מקיף לפני-אישור-ייצור-סדרתי. יועץ מנוסה מבין: FAI = אישור-החלק (part), pilot = אישור-הספק (supplier) — שני-מסלולים משלימים. results (QE01) + UD (QA11) כרגיל. הבנת-ה-FAI חיונית לתעשיות-מוסדרות — תיק-PPAP מתועד ב-lots. דרישת-לקוח-קצה שכיחה.

sections.title: Pilot Run Inspection: Inspection Type 0102
sections.en: 4.4 Pilot Run Inspection: Inspection Type 0102 Before “upgrading” the status of a first-time or new supplier to that of a regular sup- plier, a company often has stringent and comprehensive procedures and processes in place to ensure that a new supplier is able to provide material of sufficient quality. To achieve this objective, the company makes the supplier go through a series of trial runs or pilot runs of materials until the supplier is able to fulfill the quality requirements. Here, the SAP system can help by enabling the procurement and quality planners to put a series of checks and controls in place via status management. With each mate- rial’s delivery from the supplier, its corresponding inspection lot creation, results recording, and usage decision update the status (and controls) for the supplier. The following sections begin with discussing the necessary configuration settings that need to be in place for pilot run inspection so the same can then be assigned in the mas- ter data. The master data is then used to discuss the business processes of pilot run inspection.
sections.he:
לפני "שדרוג" ספק חדש לקבוע, החברה מעבירה אותו סדרת trial/pilot runs עד שהוא עומד בדרישות. ה-SAP מסייע ב-status management — כל אספקה, ‏lot, רישום, ו-usage decision מעדכנים את הסטטוס (והבקרות). להלן תצורה, נתוני אב, ותהליכים.

לפני-'שדרוג' סטטוס של-ספק-חדש לספק-רגיל, לחברה יש-לרוב נהלים-קפדניים להבטיח שהספק מסוגל-לספק חומר-באיכות-מספקת. לשם-כך, החברה מעבירה את-הספק סדרת-trial-runs או-pilot-runs של-חומרים עד-שהוא-עומד-בדרישות-האיכות, וה-SAP מסייע באמצעות-inspection-type-0102. עבור-היועץ, ה-pilot-run הוא-מסלול-ההסמכה המובנה של-ספקים-חדשים: במקום-להחליט-אד-הוק מתי-ספק-'עבר', מגדירים תהליך-סטטוסים פורמלי (דרך-status-profile ב-quality-info-record) שבו-הספק מתקדם משלב-לשלב רק-בכוח-UDs-מאשרות. ההבחנה בין-שלושת-שלבי-המסלול מהותית: source-inspection (0101, בדיקה-אצל-הספק) → pilot-run (0102, אצווי-ניסיון בבקרה-מוגברת) → רכש-רגיל (01, GR-שגרתי) — כל-שלב-נפתח רק-כשהקודם-הצליח, והמערכת-אוכפת (לא-ניתן-לדלג). זהו-יישום-מערכתי של-supplier-qualification — דרישה-סטנדרטית ב-automotive/aerospace/pharma. הבנת-ה-pilot-run חיונית — הוא-שהופך הסמכת-ספק מהחלטה-שרירותית לתהליך-מבוקר-ומתועד, עם-ראיות (lots, results, UDs) לכל-שלב. יועץ מנוסה מטמיע את-המסלול-המלא ללקוחות עם-דרישות-הסמכה, ומגדיר את-קריטריוני-המעבר (כמה-אצווי-פיילוט מוצלחים) בהתאם-למדיניות-האיכות. הסעיפים-הבאים: תצורה, checklist, ותהליך.

**הערת יועץ:** pilot-run 0102 — הסמכת-ספק-חדש: מסלול-סטטוסים (source→pilot→regular) מונע-UD. מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, status-profile ב-QI-record אוכף את-הרצף — אין-דילוג. יועץ מנוסה מטמיע ל-automotive/aerospace/pharma + מגדיר קריטריוני-מעבר (כמה-פיילוטים-מוצלחים). ההבחנה שלושת-השלבים (0101/0102/01). הופך-הסמכה מהחלטה-שרירותית לתהליך-מתועד. הבנת-ה-pilot חיונית — supplier-qualification מערכתי.

sections.title: Configuration Basics
sections.en: 4.4.1 Configuration Basics Before we cover the configuration basics of the pilot run, see Figure 4.25, which shows the Status tab of the quality info record (Transaction QI01), in which we assigned Status Profile QM_P_001. A status profile controls various business functions and whether they are allowed. A status profile is a cross-application component, so you can use it to control business functions not just in the QM area but also in other logistics and supply chain management areas. Figure 4.25 Status Profile in the Quality Info Record © 259 4.4 Pilot Run Inspection: Inspection Type 0102 In this example of a pilot run inspection, use status profile QM_P_001, which SAP delivers. Alternatively, you can amend an existing status profile or create a new one with menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality in Logistics  QM in Procure- ment  Define Status of Supply Relationships. Figure 4.26 shows the standard supplier relationship status profile QM_P_001 available in the system. Here, there are multiple statuses, and the initial status is 0001 (Supply Relationship Initiated). The initial status is denoted by the checkbox selected in the Init. status column. The low and high numbers of the status control how the system changes from one status to another. Figure 4.26 Status Profile Figure 4.27 shows the assignment of different statuses of status profile QM_P_001 to inspection lots. To assign statuses to inspection types so that the system is able to fol- low the sequence in creating various inspection types, follow menu path SAP IMG  Quality Management  Quality in Logistics  QM in Procurement  Maintain Inspection Lot Origins & Assign Inspection Types. For this example, choose three different statuses of status profile QM_P_001, and cor- respondingly assign three different inspection types: 0101, 0102, and 01. When the sys- tem receives the material from the supplier and against the purchase order, it creates an inspection lot of inspection type 0101. This is because you assigned status 0002 to inspection type 0101, and this is the first status among the three statuses. On accepted usage decision for this inspection lot (and of inspection type 0101), the system auto- matically switches to the next status, which is 0003 (and correspondingly having inspection type 0102; look for the Next status column in Figure 4.27 to see how status change works). 4 Integrating with Materials Management 260 Figure 4.27 Status Profile and Assignment to Inspection Types In Section 4.4.3, we’ll cover end-to-end business processes of all three inspection types and their statuses. Tips and Tricks If you’ve configured other specific inspection types to attend to the pilot run inspec- tion’s business scenario, you can assign these configured inspection types at this stage (Figure 4.27).
sections.he:
Figure 4.25 — לשונית Status של ה-quality info record (Transaction QI01) עם Status Profile QM_P_001. ה-status profile שולט בפונקציות עסקיות (האם מותרות) — cross-application (גם מחוץ ל-QM).
בדוגמה, ‏QM_P_001 (תקני). לשינוי/יצירה: SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality in Logistics • QM in Procurement • Define Status of Supply Relationships.
Figure 4.26 — ‏QM_P_001 התקני. מספר סטטוסים, ההתחלתי 0001 (Supply Relationship Initiated; ‏Init. status מסומן). מספרי ה-low/high שולטים במעבר.
Figure 4.27 — הקצאת סטטוסים ל-inspection lots. ל-SAP IMG • Quality Management • Quality in Logistics • QM in Procurement • Maintain Inspection Lot Origins & Assign Inspection Types. בדוגמה, שלושה סטטוסים → שלושה types: 0101, 0102, 01. בקבלת חומר, המערכת יוצרת type 0101 (סטטוס 0002, הראשון). בקבלה accepted, המערכת עוברת ל-0003 (type 0102; ‏Next status). (תהליכים — 4.4.3.)
**Tips and Tricks:** ניתן להקצות types מותאמים (Figure 4.27).

לפני-יסודות-התצורה של-ה-pilot-run: ה-Status-tab של-ה-quality-info-record (Transaction-QI01) שבו-הוקצה Status-Profile QM_P_001. ה-status-profile שולט בפונקציות-עסקיות שונות והאם-הן-מותרות; זהו-רכיב-cross-application, כך-שניתן-להשתמש-בו לבקרת-פונקציות גם-מחוץ-ל-QM, בתחומי-לוגיסטיקה-ו-SCM אחרים. עבור-היועץ, ה-status-profile הוא-מנוע-המסלול: הוא-מגדיר סדרת-סטטוסים (למשל, source-inspection → pilot-run → released) ולכל-סטטוס — אילו-פעולות-עסקיות מותרות (אילו-inspection-types נוצרים, האם-רכש-מלא-מותר). ההקצאה ב-quality-info-record (רמת-חומר-ספק!) אומרת: מסלול-ההסמכה חל-על-השילוב-הספציפי — ספק-חדש לחומר-X מוסמך בנפרד-מחומר-Y. ההבחנה בין-status-profile (המנוע-הגנרי, cross-application מ-general-status-management) לשימושו-כאן (הסמכת-ספקים ב-QM) מהותית: אותו-מנגנון משמש-גם ב-PM, PS ועוד — ידע-מועבר. QM_P_001 הוא-ה-profile הסטנדרטי למסלול — מתחילים-ממנו ומתאימים. הבנת-התצורה חיונית — ה-status-profile הוא-שאוכף את-רצף-השלבים; בלעדיו, ה-types (0101/0102) קיימים אך-שום-דבר לא-מחייב את-סדרם. יועץ מנוסה מעתיק את-QM_P_001 ל-Z-profile ומתאים את-הסטטוסים-והמעברים למדיניות-ההסמכה של-הלקוח.

**הערת יועץ:** config pilot — status-profile QM_P_001 ב-QI-record (QI01, Status-tab). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, ה-profile = מכונת-הסטטוסים: לכל-סטטוס אילו-types/פעולות מותרים. cross-application (general-status-management — משמש גם-PM/PS). יועץ מנוסה מעתיק ל-Z-profile ומתאים למדיניות-הלקוח. ההבחנה מנוע-גנרי מול-שימוש-QM. הקצאה ברמת-חומר-ספק = הסמכה-פר-שילוב. הבנת-ה-profile חיונית — בלעדיו ה-types קיימים אך-אין-רצף-אכוף.

sections.title: QM Master Data Checklist
sections.en: 4.4.2 QM Master Data Checklist The following is the QM master data checklist:  Inspection types 0101, 0102, 01 active in QM view of material master  Quality information record: procurement  Inspection plan usage 51 (for inspection type 0101), 52 (for inspection type 0102), and 5 (for inspection type 01), and all three inspection plans having status 4 (for released)
sections.he:
**רשימת נתוני אב:**
• inspection types 0101, 0102, 01 פעילים.
• quality information record: procurement.
• inspection plan usage 51 (ל-0101), 52 (ל-0102), 5 (ל-01), כולם status 4.

checklist-נתוני-האב ל-pilot-run: inspection-types 0101, 0102, ו-01 פעילים ב-QM-view של-מאסטר-החומר; quality-information-record לרכש; ו-inspection-plans עם-usage-51 (ל-0101), usage-52 (ל-0102), ו-usage-5 (ל-01) — שלושתם בסטטוס-4 (released). עבור-היועץ, ה-checklist הקצר-הזה הוא-תמצית של-שרשרת-תלות שלמה, וכל-חוליה-חסרה שוברת את-המסלול בשקט: שלושת-ה-types במאסטר (עם-Active!) — בלעדיהם lots לא-נוצרים; ה-QI-record — בלעדיו אין-status-profile ואין-מסלול; שלושת-ה-plans עם-usage-נפרד-לכל-type — בלעדיהם lots נוצרים-ריקים (בלי-מאפיינים). ההבחנה בין-שלושת-ה-usages (51/52/5) קריטית-ודקה: כל-inspection-type מושך-plan לפי-ה-usage שלו — plan-אחד עם-usage-שגוי אומר שסוג-בדיקה-אחד במסלול יישאר בלי-תוכן. סטטוס-4 (released) הוא-תנאי-הפעלה — plan בסטטוס-2 (in-creation) לא-נמשך. הבנת-ה-checklist חיונית — הוא-בדיקת-השלמות שמפרידה בין-מסלול-עובד למסלול-שבור-בשקט. יועץ מנוסה מריץ את-ה-checklist הזה כ-validation לפני-הדגמת-המסלול ללקוח, ובודק בכל-תקלת-'lot-ריק' קודם-כל את-התאמת-ה-usage.

**הערת יועץ:** checklist pilot — types 0101/0102/01 פעילים במאסטר; QI-record; plans עם-usage-51/52/5, כולם-status-4 (released). מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, כל-type מושך-plan לפי-ה-usage שלו — usage-שגוי = lot-ריק לשלב-אחד. יועץ מנוסה מריץ את-ה-checklist כ-validation לפני-הדגמה; בכל-'lot-ריק' בודק-usage תחילה. ההבחנה שלושת-ה-usages (51/52/5) — דקה-וקריטית. status-2 לא-נמשך. הבנת-ה-checklist חיונית — שרשרת-תלות שלמה בשלוש-שורות.

sections.title: Business Processes of Pilot Run Inspection
sections.en: 4.4.3 Business Processes of Pilot Run Inspection In this business process, the first step is to create a purchase order for new a supplier and partially or completely receive goods. The system creates an inspection lot of inspection type 0101. Perform results recording, followed by making a usage decision and stock posting. The system considers the usage decision at this stage to decide whether it should move to the next status or remain the same. An accepted usage decision for inspection type 0101 triggers the system to create the inspection lot of inspection type 0102, and on the next goods receipt against the same purchase order or even a different purchase order. Again, the system considers results recorded and usage decision taken for the inspection lot of inspection type 0102 to see if it should switch the status to inspection type 01 or not. Finally, the accepted usage decision of inspection type 0102 © 261 4.4 Pilot Run Inspection: Inspection Type 0102 leads to the system updating to inspection type 01. You then pay the supplier for goods delivered. The business process of the pilot run inspection is shown in Figure 4.28. Figure 4.28 Business Processes in Model Inspection Create a purchase order using Transaction ME21N; in this example, the system creates purchase order number 4500001848. On goods receipt against the purchase order (using Transaction MIGO), the system creates inspection lot 10000000661, as shown in Figure 4.29. Figure 4.29 Prototype Release: Inspection Type 0101 This inspection lot is of inspection type 0101. Notice that the system denotes the description of the inspection type as a qualification model and is the same as shown Purchase order Goods receipt QM inspection lot (Insp. type 0101) QM inspection lot (Insp. type 0102) QM inspection lot (Insp. type 01) Goods receipt Goods receipt Invoice receipt 4 Integrating with Materials Management 262 earlier in Figure 4.27. Record the results of this inspection lot, take its accepted usage decision, and perform a stock posting to unrestricted-use stock. Perform another goods receipt for the same or different purchase order, and this time, the system creates an inspection lot of inspection type 0102, thereby adhering to the sequence that we configured in Figure 4.27. This is shown in Figure 4.30 where the sys- tem creates an inspection lot 10000000678. Record the results of this inspection lot, take its accepted usage decision, and perform a stock posting to unrestricted-use stock. Correspondingly, the system updates the status of the inspection lot. Figure 4.30 Preliminary and Production Release: Inspection Type 0102 On the next goods receipt against the same or a different purchase order, this time, the system creates inspection lot 10000000685 of inspection type 01 (see Figure 4.31). Figure 4.32 shows the Status tab of the quality information record, in which the details of the inspection lot shown in Figure 4.31 are accordingly updated. © 263 4.4 Pilot Run Inspection: Inspection Type 0102 Figure 4.31 Goods Receipt Inspection Figure 4.32 Status Management To summarize, let’s look at how the system updates the quality information record of the material QM003 and supplier EWM17-SU01 combination during the entire busi- ness process of the pilot run. The Status tab of the display quality information record (Transaction QI03) updates the statuses per the actions performed and incorporates the relevant inspection lot numbers. These inspection lots, 10000000681 and 10000000678, are the same as shown previously. It’s important to note that in Figure 4.32, the status is from before we recorded results and made a usage decision and stock posting. Once we do this, the system updates the status of inspection lot 10000000685 as shown in Figure 4.32. It updates this status after you undertake the usage decision for 4 Integrating with Materials Management 264 the inspection lot as 10000000685. Had it been a rejected inspection lot, the system would have maintained the previous status until acceptable results (and a usage deci- sion) were in place.
sections.he:
הזמנה לספק חדש וקבלה חלקית/מלאה → המערכת יוצרת type 0101. רישום, ‏usage decision, ‏posting. קבלה accepted ל-0101 → המערכת יוצרת type 0102 ב-GR הבא. קבלה accepted ל-0102 → המערכת מעדכנת ל-type 01. ואז תשלום (Figure 4.28).
(זרימה: Purchase order → Goods receipt → QM lot [0101] → Goods receipt → QM lot [0102] → Goods receipt → QM lot [01] → Invoice receipt.)
צרו הזמנה (Transaction ME21N) — 4500001848. ב-GR (Transaction MIGO) — lot 10000000661 (Figure 4.29), type 0101 (qualification model; ‏Figure 4.27). רשמו, קבלו (accepted), ‏posting ל-unrestricted.
GR נוסף → type 0102 (Figure 4.30 — lot 10000000678). רשמו, קבלו, ‏posting.
GR נוסף → type 01 (Figure 4.31 — lot 10000000685).
Figure 4.32 — לשונית Status של ה-record מתעדכנת.
בסיכום, לשונית Status (Transaction QI03) של QM003/EWM17-SU01 מתעדכנת לפי הפעולות עם מספרי ה-lots. לאחר רישום/usage decision/posting, המערכת מעדכנת את סטטוס 10000000685. אילו נדחה, היה נשמר הסטטוס הקודם עד תוצאות מקובלות.

התהליך: יוצרים purchase-order לספק-חדש ומקבלים סחורה (חלקית/מלאה); המערכת יוצרת lot מסוג-0101. מבצעים results, UD, ו-stock-posting. המערכת שוקלת את-ה-UD להחלטה אם-לעבור-לסטטוס-הבא או-להישאר; UD-מאשרת ל-0101 מפעילה יצירת-lot-0102 בקבלות-הבאות, וכן-הלאה עד-ההסמכה המלאה. עבור-היועץ, זו-מכונת-מצבים חיה: הסטטוס ב-QI-record מכתיב איזה-inspection-type נוצר בכל-GR — בסטטוס-source נוצרים lots-0101; אושר → הסטטוס-מתקדם → הקבלות-הבאות יוצרות-0102; אושרו-מספיק → הסטטוס-מגיע-לרגיל → מעתה-lots-01 שגרתיים. ההבחנה המרכזית: המעבר אינו-ידני אלא-מונע-UD — ראיית-איכות בפועל היא-שמקדמת את-הספק, לא-החלטה-פקידותית. UD-דוחה משאירה (או-מחזירה) את-הסטטוס — הספק-'נתקע' עד-שישתפר. כל-המסלול מתועד: רצף-ה-lots וה-UDs הוא-תיק-ההסמכה של-הספק (audit-ready). הבנת-התהליך חיונית — הוא-שממחיש איך-status-profile + types + UDs מתחברים למכונה-אחת. יועץ מנוסה מדגים ללקוח את-כל-המסלול על-ספק-דמה (PO→0101→אישור→PO→0102→אישור→PO→01) כ-acceptance-test, ומוודא שהמעברים-קורים אוטומטית.

**הערת יועץ:** תהליך pilot — מכונת-מצבים: סטטוס קובע איזה-type נוצר ב-GR; UD-מאשרת מקדמת-סטטוס → ה-GR-הבא יוצר את-ה-type-הבא. מנקודת-מבט-מעשית, דחייה = הספק-נתקע עד-שיפור. יועץ מנוסה מדגים מסלול-מלא על-ספק-דמה (PO→0101→אישור→0102→אישור→01) כ-acceptance-test. רצף-lots+UDs = תיק-הסמכה audit-ready. ההבחנה מעבר-מונע-UD (ראיות) מול-ידני (שרירות). הבנת-התהליך חיונית — כך-הכל-מתחבר.

sections.title: Subcontracting: Inspection Type 0130
sections.en: 4.5 Subcontracting: Inspection Type 0130 The subcontracting process begins when the company hands over (issues) the compo- nents to a subcontractor, who is usually a supplier, against the subcontracting pur- chase order, to either assemble or add value to the product. The company takes the components’ inventory out of its books, and the same is reflected in the supplier’s inventory.
